jobs.title: Director of Engineering
jobs.description:
Prismatic is the integration platform that helps B2B software companies build integrations fast and deliver them at scale. We're turning integrations from a bottleneck into a growth driver for hundreds of companies, from high-growth startups to Fortune 500s.

Our platform handles everything that breaks at scale, so teams can ship integrations, not infrastructure. It provides flexible, AI-enabled build experiences through code-native, low-code, and an embedded workflow builder, plus self-service configuration and an embedded marketplace.

Prismatic is well-funded with strong product-market fit and a high-agency, driven, collaborative culture.

About the role:

We're hiring a Director of Engineering to lead the Engineering organization. This role reports directly to the CTO and is the single engineering leader across two teams currently totaling 8 engineers, with a plan towards ~12. This is not a manager-of-managers role today, you'll be directly managing the team. The ideal candidate is someone excited to directly lead a team of high performing Senior+ Engineers. Beyond the people management side, you'll own the full scope of execution: process, feature delivery, quality, while maintaining a highly engaged group of people.

Prismatic is built primarily in TypeScript (both frontend and backend), with some Python and Django on the backend and React on the frontend. We build a sophisticated low-code integration builder, an SDK and tools for building integrations fully in TypeScript, and features powering our customers' AI agent functionality. All of this on top of a high-scale, performance critical platform. While this is not a hands-on building role, being confident in the technology, and the challenges of a scaling a developer facing SaaS platform will be crucial to high quality decision making.

What will you do:

Partner with Product to drive execution across all initiatives; on-time delivery, quality and consistency.
Manage, coach, and grow all engineers directly, regular 1:1s, high-quality feedback, and growth conversations.
Staff each initiative and pair it with the right Tech Lead; develop the Tech Lead bench so ownership keeps spreading.
Surface and resolve cross-initiative risks: staffing gaps, priority collisions, delivery delays.
Contribute to hiring: help us find, close, and ramp the next several engineers.
Contribute technically where it helps, this isn't day-to-day code, but helping with architecture review, tech-debt analysis, scaling challenges, etc.

About you:

Demonstrated progression from a technical role to a leadership role, with demonstrated experience managing multiple teams of Engineers in a fully remote environment.
You've operated as the senior-most engineering leader in a group, or close to it; comfortable being the only manager, without a layer beneath you.
Significant technical experience in at least one area of our stack; able to speak credibly in architecture and scoping conversations.
Proven partner to Product on scope, estimation, and delivery commitments.
Experience managing remote teams; excellent written communication
Thrives on accountability, bias to action, strong desire to empower individuals and win as a team.
Experience at a scaling SaaS startup in varying roles.

Bonus if you have experience with/in:

AI-enabled software development
Developer-facing products
High scale SaaS platforms

Our tech stack:

Cloud - AWS
Databases - Postgres, Redis
Backend API - Python & Django
Backend Integration Platform - Typescript
Frontend - Typescript & React
SDKs - Typescript

Pay range:

The pay range for this role is $220,000 - $250,000/yr, plus equity
Most new hires start near the midpoint based on their relevant experience, skills, and qualifications, with room to grow within the range over time.

Life at Prismatic

Our Values

Our values shape everything we do—how we make decisions, collaborate, and operate day to day.

Give a Shit
– We bring passion and drive to our work. We believe what we're doing matters and we treat it that way.
Progress Over Perfection
– We value daily progress, moving fast, and iterating. We prefer a good solution now over a perfect one later.
Same Team
– We recognize that we succeed or fail as a group and help each other out. We don't tolerate assholes.

What to expect at Prismatic

We operate with urgency, ownership, and high standards. You'll be joining a team that's highly engaged, customer-obsessed, and constantly solving new problems that help B2B software companies scale their integration strategies.

To support this pace, we're also intentional about sustainability. We offer comprehensive benefits, unlimited PTO, and top-tier equipment for remote work.

Benefits

🏡 Remote work:
Our team works remotely across the US; we travel together 2x times a year for company kick-offs and mid-year meetings.

🏖️ Unlimited PTO:
We have an unlimited & flexible paid time off (PTO) policy that encourages our team to recharge when they need to.

🏥 Medical, dental & vision:
Prismatic offers high-quality medical (Cigna Medical), dental (Guardian Dental) and vision (Guardian VSP) care for full-time employees and their dependents.

🛡️ Life insurance:
We provide company-paid life insurance, short-term disability insurance, and long-term disability insurance through Guardian.

🏦 401(k):
Our 401(k) plan is through Empower with 4% company match - 100% of the first 3% and 50% of the next 2%.

💻 Computer & technology equipment:
We provide the equipment you need to do your best work, applicable to your role + $1k new hire setup stipend.

Ready to Help Turn Integrations Into Growth Drivers?

We want diverse perspectives and experiences. If this role excites you but you're not sure you check every box, apply anyway. We consider every application thoughtfully and will either move forward with you, connect you with another team that might be a better fit, or keep in touch for future opportunities.

jobs.title: Sr. Director, Engineering
jobs.description:
Company

Qualcomm Technologies, Inc.

Job Area

Engineering Group, Engineering Group > Software Engineering

General Summary

Qualcomm is seeking an exceptional Senior Director, Software Engineering
to lead software architecture, development, and execution for our next generation AI accelerator platform. This leader will own the end-to-end software strategy for a breakthrough AI compute architecture, spanning system software, runtimes, compilers, AI frameworks, SDKs, performance optimization, and developer enablement.

As the software leader for a flagship AI accelerator program, you will drive the vision, roadmap, and execution of a world-class software stack that enables cutting-edge generative AI, machine learning, and high-performance computing workloads across Datacenter applications. You will work closely with silicon architects, hardware design teams, AI framework, product management, ecosystem partners, and key customers to define and deliver differentiated platform capabilities that maximize hardware performance/efficiency as well as developer productivity.

This role requires a unique combination of deep technical expertise, organizational leadership, strategic thinking, and excellence in execution. The ideal candidate has a proven track record of leading large software teams on complex semiconductor platforms with an emphasis on AI.

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 10+ years of Software Engineering or related work experience.

OR

Master's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 9+ years of Software Engineering or related work experience.

OR

PhD in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 8+ years of Software Engineering or related work experience.

4+ years of work experience with Programming Language such as C, C++, Java, Python, etc.

Key Responsibilities

Serve as the software technical leader for Qualcomm's next generation AI accelerator platform.
Define and execute the current Datacenter software vision, architecture, roadmap, and delivery strategy aligned with product and business objectives for the new AI accelerator
Lead multiple engineering organizations responsible for:
System software and firmware design and development.
Device drivers and kernel integration
AI runtimes and execution engines with emphasis on graphs spanning multiple NPU.
Compiler technologies and graph optimization
ML frameworks and ecosystem enablement
Platform SDKs, APIs, tools, profiling, and debugging solutions
Performance optimization and benchmarking
Validation, quality, and release engineering
Partner with silicon architecture and hardware engineering teams to co-design hardware and software features that maximize AI performance, efficiency, programmability, and scalability.
Drive software readiness across all chip development milestones, including architecture definition, emulation, pre-silicon enablement, bring-up, validation, customer engagements, and production release.
Establish performance, power, reliability, and usability goals for the platform software stack.
Lead strategic engagements with key customers, hyperscalers, ecosystem partners and standards organizations.
Build, mentor, and scale high-performing engineering teams across multiple geographic locations.
Foster a culture of technical excellence, innovation, accountability, collaboration, and operational rigor.
Present program status, technical strategy, and key decisions to executive leadership.

Desired Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or related field.
15+ years of software engineering experience, including significant leadership responsibilities.
8+ years of experience leading large, globally distributed engineering organizations.
Experience delivering software platforms for complex SoC, accelerator, GPU, NPU, CPU, DSP, datacenter, or high-performance computing products.
Deep expertise in one or more of the following:
AI/ML software stacks
Compiler technologies
Runtime systems
Operating systems
Distributed computing
High-performance computing
Heterogeneous computing architectures
Demonstrated success driving cross-functional execution involving hardware and software co-development.
Strong understanding of modern AI workloads in particular inference for large language models/serving frameworks, multimodal AI, recommendation systems, and generative AI applications.

Preferred Qualifications

Advanced degree (MS or PhD) in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, AI/ML, or related discipline.
Experience leading software development for AI accelerators, GPUs, NPUs, TPUs, or custom silicon platforms.
Expertise in compiler technologies such as MLIR, LLVM or similar frameworks.
Experience with AI frameworks including PyTorch, TensorFlow, JAX, ONNX, Mojo, Triton or equivalent ecosystems.
Strong understanding of accelerator memory hierarchies, interconnects, parallel programming models, and performance optimization.
Expertise in compiler technologies such as Triton, MLIR, LLVM or similar frameworks
Experience supporting hyperscale cloud deployments and enterprise AI infrastructure.
Track record of delivering industry-leading developer platforms and software ecosystems.
Publications, patents, or recognized technical leadership in AI systems or high-performance computing.

Leadership Characteristics

Visionary technology leader with the ability to define and execute transformative platform strategies.
Exceptional communicator capable of influencing executive stakeholders, customers, and engineering teams.
Strong systems thinker who can balance technical innovation, customer needs, and business priorities.
Proven ability to attract, develop, and retain world-class engineering talent.
Demonstrated ability to lead through ambiguity and deliver results in highly complex environments.

jobs.title: Director of Engineering - Data & AI Platform
jobs.description:
The next part of your journey is right around the corner — with The Standard.

A genuine desire to make a difference in the lives of others is the foundation for everything we do. With a customer-first mindset and an intentional focus on building strong teams, we’ve been able to uphold our legacy of financial stability while investing in new, innovative technologies that support the needs of our customers. Our high-performance culture focused on operational excellence thrives thanks to remarkable people united by compassion and a customer-first commitment. Are you ready to make a difference?

Job Summary

The Director, Data & AI Platform Engineering leads the engineering strategy, development, delivery, and operational excellence of the enterprise Data & AI Platform. This role combines enterprise technology leadership with the development of high-performing engineering teams spanning data engineering, software engineering, AI/ML platform engineering, DevOps, DevSecOps, DataOps, MLOps, and LLMOps.

Working closely with Product, Architecture, Governance, Security, Risk, Enterprise Delivery, Analytics & BI, and AI Product teams, the Director delivers a governed, reusable, self-service platform foundation. This leader is responsible for engineering execution across Foundational Data & AI Products, Integration & Runtime, and the Shared Substrate, with capabilities designed to be defined once, governed once, and consumed by many.

Key Responsibilities:

Engineering Leadership and Team Development

Lead and develop multidisciplinary engineering teams while building a culture of ownership, collaboration, engineering excellence, and continuous improvement.

Coach engineering managers, technical leads, architects, and senior engineers; build succession plans and strengthen leadership capacity.
Lead workforce planning, hiring, onboarding, performance management, capability development, and talent retention.
Establish clear accountability and decision-making across distributed teams and engineering disciplines.

Platform Engineering Strategy and Delivery

Set and execute the engineering strategy for the shared Data & AI Platform in partnership with platform product leadership and architecture.

Deliver platform-managed capabilities across Foundational Data & AI Products, Integration & Runtime, and Shared Substrate.
Guide engineering investment in canonical data products, the governed context foundation, model and tool gateways, registries, agent runtime, APIs, lakehouse, catalog, compute, storage, and golden-path automation.
Balance near-term delivery with platform sustainability, reuse, scalability, and the thin-platform boundary.

Operational Excellence and Governance

Ensure platform services are reliable, secure, observable, supportable, and operated to published service objectives.

Establish engineering standards for architecture, CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code, automated testing, observability, incident response, resilience, documentation, and operational readiness.
Partner with Governance, Security, Risk, and Architecture so policy is technically enforced while architecture pattern-setting remains distinct from policy ownership.
Use delivery, reliability, quality, contract-conformance, adoption, and consumer-feedback measures to drive continuous improvement.

Enterprise Partnership and Execution

Build strong partnerships across business, data, AI, product, architecture, governance, and enterprise technology organizations.

Communicate engineering priorities, delivery progress, operational health, risks, dependencies, and outcomes to senior stakeholders.
Enable self-service golden paths so consumers can build compliant solutions without embedding or waiting on the platform team.
Manage capacity, vendors, dependencies, and organizational scaling in alignment with the platform roadmap.

Skills And Background You’ll Need

Education:
A Bachelor’s degree is required.

Experience:
Minimum 8 – 10 years’ experience within IT and 3+ years’ experience managing IT employees

Demonstrated experience leading enterprise-scale data, technology, platform, product, or analytics organizations and developing high-performing teams.
Strong strategic planning, prioritization, communication, stakeholder partnership, and organizational change leadership skills.
Experience operating in a regulated environment with governance, security, privacy, audit, risk, and access-control expectations.

Key Behaviors of a Successful Candidate

Driving Success: Demonstrates energy and persistence when tackling complex challenges and views difficult problems as opportunities to create value.
Winning Together: Builds trust and strong working relationships across teams, values diverse perspectives, and fosters collaboration to achieve shared objectives.
Strategic Visioning: Considers future scenarios, opportunities, and risks to develop thoughtful recommendations that align with the company's long-term strategic objectives.

Why Join The Standard?

We have built an enduring legacy of stability, financial strength and exceptional customer service through the contributions of the service-oriented people who choose to work at The Standard. To ensure we can attract and retain the best talent, when you join The Standard you can expect:

A rich benefits package including medical, dental, vision and a 401(k) plan with matching company contributions
An annual incentive bonus plan
Generous paid time off including 11 holidays, 2 wellness days, and 8 volunteer hours annually — PTO increases with tenure
A supportive, responsive management approach and opportunities for career growth and advancement
Paid parental leave and adoption/surrogacy assistance
An employee giving program that double matches your donations to eligible nonprofits and schools

In addition to the competitive salary range below, our employee-focused benefits support work-life balance. Learn more about working at The Standard.

Eligibility to participate in an incentive program is subject to the rules governing the program and plan. Any award depends on a variety of factors including individual and organizational performance.

The actual compensation for this role will be based on a combination of education and experience, knowledge and skills, position budget, internal equity, and market data.

$147,750.00 - $280,750.00

Positions will be posted for at least 5 days from original posting date.

The beautiful Doubletree by Hilton Austin will turn 40 years old this year, but with a new renovation, she is looking better than ever. The charming property, with its Spanish Colonial design and contemporary decor, makes it a great place for guests and associates looking for an upscale work experience. Managed by HEI Hospitality, we offer an exceptional benefit package including a robust and flexible paid time off plan available to you after only 90 days. We have a choice of 4 prominent healthcare plans with options to meet anyone’s needs and are available to you the first of the month after you start. You may be the perfect candidate for this or for other roles within our organization!

3+ years of hands-on experience at a comparable location. All HEI Chief Engineers are working Chief’s.

jobs.description:
ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD.

At AMD, we believe technology has the power to solve the world’s most important challenges. From advancing healthcare and scientific discovery to powering AI and the technologies people rely on every day, innovation at AMD is shaping the future.

Whether you’re designing next-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or bringing leading edge products to market, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger — technology that moves the world forward. Join us and, together, we’ll advance your career.

The Role

AMD is seeking a visionary and highly technical Director of Instinct Stack Architecture to lead architecture strategy, technical direction, and cross-functional execution across the AMD Instinct product portfolio. This leader will drive end-to-end architectural alignment across hardware, firmware, system software, security, reliability, serviceability, platform management, and infrastructure to enable next-generation AI and HPC solutions.

This role leads a high-performing architecture organization responsible for defining scalable system architectures, driving technology strategy, and ensuring architectural consistency across multiple products, programs, domains, and engineering verticals.

The Person

The ideal candidate is a proven technical leader with strong system-level thinking, deep architecture experience, and the ability to lead highly functional teams across multiple verticals. They can operate effectively in a matrixed environment, influence senior stakeholders, align cross-functional teams, and translate long-term architecture vision into executable roadmaps.

jobs.title: Director of Operational Excellence Engineering
jobs.description:
The Director of Operational Excellence Engineering will serve as a strategic individual contributor responsible for driving operational excellence and system reliability across B2C retirement platforms. Reporting directly to the Head Retirement Solutions Individual Technology (B2C), this role is essential to achieving our Executive Committee mandate to make 2026 the year of operational excellence, with particular focus on serving our top institutions, TRAC users, and participants.

This position will function as the Technology lead for B2C operational excellence initiatives, working in close partnership with the Retirement Technology Operations & Managed Services organization to establish unified standards and practices across service delivery functions. The role brings critical parity to our operating model, mirroring a parallel position being established for B2B operations.

Key Responsibilities And Duties

Operational Excellence & Root Cause Analysis – Conduct comprehensive analysis of system performance, service incidents, and outage patterns to identify systemic issues and their underlying causes. Synthesize data from incident reports, monitoring systems, and operational metrics to pinpoint areas where structural improvements will yield the greatest impact on system reliability and participant experience. Develop holistic remediation strategies that address root problems rather than symptoms.
Site Reliability Engineering & System Resilience – Champion Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) principles and practices to build more resilient systems. Identify opportunities to implement graceful degradation patterns, ensuring systems maintain core functionality even during partial failures. Evaluate current architecture and operational practices to recommend and drive implementation of fail-safe mechanisms, redundancy strategies, and automated recovery procedures that minimize participant impact during system stress or component failures.
Zero Tolerance Compliance & Monitoring – Establish and maintain rigorous monitoring frameworks and early warning systems in support of our zero tolerance posture for system outages. Define key performance indicators, establish escalation protocols, and ensure real-time visibility into system health across all B2C platforms. Develop proactive intervention strategies that prevent incidents before they impact participants.
Managed Services Oversight & SLA Management – Serve as the primary oversight lead for our Accenture managed services partnership, ensuring contractual service level agreements are consistently met for all B2C operations. Track service delivery metrics, conduct regular performance reviews, identify gaps in service delivery, and drive accountability for remediation. Maintain detailed scorecards and documentation that demonstrate compliance and highlight areas requiring attention.
Executive Reporting & Communication – Develop and deliver regular executive-level reporting on operational excellence initiatives, system reliability metrics, incident trends, and program progress. Create dashboards, presentations, and written reports that clearly communicate both technical and business impacts of operational improvements. Translate complex technical information into business outcomes that resonate with EC-level stakeholders.
Cross-Functional Partnership & Synergy Building – Work collaboratively with Retirement Technology Operations & Managed Services leadership to identify opportunities to create operational synergies, eliminate redundancies, and establish consistent practices across service delivery functions. Ensure alignment between development, operations, and managed services teams in pursuit of common operational excellence goals.

Experience establishing and managing monitoring frameworks, KPIs, and escalation protocols for production systems
Experience managing third-party managed services partnerships, including SLA tracking, performance management, and vendor accountability
Experience developing and delivering executive-level reporting, dashboards, and presentations that translate technical complexity into business outcomes
Ability to assess complex enterprise architectures and translate findings into clear, actionable strategies that simplify systems, reduce fragility, and strengthen operational resilience

Experience operating as a strategic individual contributor in a matrixed organization, driving outcomes through influence rather than direct authority
Familiarity with AI-powered monitoring, observability, and automated remediation tools

Experience governing increasingly autonomous or AI-augmented operational systems

Experience managing large-scale vendor relationships, specifically with Accenture or similar global managed services providers

jobs.title: Data Engineering Manager, Sr
jobs.description:
Overview

Old National Bank has been serving clients and communities since 1834. With over $70 billion in total assets, we are a regional powerhouse deeply rooted in the communities we serve. As a trusted partner, we thrive on helping our clients achieve their goals and dreams, and we are committed to social responsibility and investing in our communities through volunteering and charitable giving.

We continually seek highly motivated and talented individuals as our people are critical to our success. In return, we offer competitive compensation with our salary and incentive program, in addition to medical, dental, and vision insurance. 401K, continuing education opportunities and an employee assistance program are also included in our benefit suite. Old National also offers a variety of Impact Network Groups led by team members who are passionate about driving engagement, creating awareness of diverse backgrounds and experiences, and building inclusion across the organization. We offer a unique opportunity to join a growing, community and client-focused company that is firmly rooted in its core values.

Responsibilities

The Senior Data Engineering Manager leads a data engineering team within the Data Technology organization, overseeing the development and delivery of technical solutions that support the bank's data strategy. This leader sets vision and direction for their team's domain, ensures alignment with the Data Office and stakeholders across the bank and IT, and collaborates with other product owners and managers to deliver customer value. The Senior Data Engineering Manager guides and mentors data engineers, fosters a culture of innovation and excellence, and promotes best practices in data engineering and agile methodologies. This role reports to the Chief Data Technology Officer and works closely with the Enterprise Architecture, Info Security, and Data Governance organizations.

Salary Range

The salary range for this position is $98,400/yr - $199,000/yr plus bonus. The base salary indicated for this position reflects the compensation range applicable to all levels of the role across the United States. Actual salary offers within this range may vary based on a number of factors, including the specific responsibilities of the position, the candidate’s relevant skills and professional experience, educational qualifications, and geographic location.

Collaborate with product owners, managers, and stakeholders to define and deliver data solutions that drive customer value.
Oversee design, development, testing, deployment, and maintenance of data products, platforms, or services within the team's scope.
Ensure quality, reliability, scalability, and security of delivered solutions.
Establish and enforce data engineering standards, best practices, and guidelines.
Ensure compliance with enterprise data architecture and governance frameworks.
Monitor, troubleshoot, and resolve data and technical issues within the team's domain.
Provide technical guidance, mentorship, and coaching to data engineers.
Foster a culture of innovation and excellence.

Key Accountability 2: Team Management & Strategic Direction

Lead and manage the data engineering team including hiring, onboarding, performance management, career development, and retention.
Define and communicate the team's vision, roadmap, and backlog in alignment with the Data Technology organization's strategy.
Ensure alignment with the Data Office and other stakeholders across the bank.
Provide technical guidance, mentorship, and coaching to develop team capabilities.
Foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and excellence.
Define and execute a data engineering strategy supporting the bank's data vision and goals.
Align with enterprise data architecture and governance frameworks.

Key Accountability 3: Solution Development & Operational Excellence

Manage end-to-end delivery of data solutions, from ideation to deployment and ongoing support.
Apply agile and lean principles and practices (Scrum, Kanban).
Establish and enforce standards, best practices, and guidelines within the team's domain.
Ensure compliance with enterprise data architecture and governance frameworks.
Drive operational excellence through monitoring, issue resolution, and continuous improvement.
Ensure data quality and security across all team deliverables.

Key Accountability 4: Forward Thinking & Leadership Communications

Stay abreast of latest trends and technologies in data engineering, cloud platforms, and the team's domain area.
Evaluate and recommend new solutions , tools, and approaches.
Demonstrate technical passion and curiosity to explore and adopt new technologies .
Prepare and present data engineering reports, dashboards, and metrics to senior leadership and business partners.

Develops Talent - Advocates for talent development as an organizational imperative and develops people according to talent strategy needs cultivating a diverse succession “pipeline ” . Continuously assesses talent across the bank to develop an understanding of capabilities and potential and leverages talent as a corporate resource to meet needs today and into the future . Cultivates an environment of trust and optimizes others' talents and capabilities across the organization, driving a culture of continuous coaching and feedback . Retains, attracts and recruits top diverse talent leveraging opportunistic hires to meet current and future people needs at Old National .
Promotes Change - Explains the business need, impact, and anticipated benefits of the change while engaging stakeholders to gain buy-in. Shapes and transforms culture by building an organizational culture of change agility. Manages risk associated with the change through appropriate contingency planning . Promotes change where it is needed to stay relevant and successful while creating conditions for team members to creatively generate new ways to enhance Old National's ability to succeed .
Strategy in Action - Develops, communicates, and aligns organization with a clear vision and strategy empowering team members to take action . Maintains a strong network of advisors and leverages resources to stay current on emerging trends and market factors that may influence ONB’s strategy. Envisions how Old National's responses to trends may impact our longer-term vision and strategy while formulating a clear strategy that will accelerate ONB towards its strategic goals . jobs.title: Vice President, Technology
jobs.description:
Pets deserve the best care. At Vetsource, we build the foundation for success, enabling those in the pet healthcare profession and industry to thrive. Our data-powered platform simplifies processes and streamlines systems, helping those we serve create tighter bonds with their customers. From prescription management and pet owner engagement to veterinary business performance data and insights, Vetsource provides comprehensive solutions that give our customers more time and flexibility, and help them foster strong relationships and positive experiences. In a rapidly evolving world, we’re constantly seeking new ways to help our customers chart a course for a better, brighter future for pets and those who care for them.

If you love pets, want to have an impact and join a fantastic organization, Vetsource could be the place for you.

At Vetsource, our teams, much like our customers, are represented through diverse perspectives, life experiences, unique strengths (and love for animals). We are an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace.

We are a team of real people looking for great people to join us, which is why applications are carefully and thoughtfully reviewed by our team. We know that when considering a new opportunity, it's common to weigh your qualifications against the listed job criteria. That said, even if you don’t meet 100% of the job requirements but feel you would be a good fit for the role, we still encourage you to apply!

Who We Are Looking For

Vice President, Technology

The Vice President, Technology is a senior technology executive responsible for leading software engineering and enterprise technology, delivering the platforms, systems, and capabilities that power Vetsource's operations and enable the company's next phase of growth. Reporting to the Chief Technology Officer, this leader oversees the technology platforms supporting pharmacy operations, supply chain, finance, workplace technology, and enterprise operations while driving modernization, automation, and AI adoption across the business.

A key responsibility of this role is the evolution of Vetsource's proprietary fulfillment and operational technology platforms into a strategic competitive advantage. This includes defining and executing the next generation fulfillment architecture leveraging AI, robotics, intelligent workflow orchestration, and automation to create a scalable competitive advantage for Vetsource.

This executive partners closely with leaders across the business to shape the technology strategy and roadmap to advance our mission to deliver personalized care for pets while improving operational speed, reliability, scalability, and cost efficiency.

Beyond technology delivery, this leader will build high-performing teams, develop organizational capabilities, and drive transformation with a new operating model that accelerates innovation while maintaining operational excellence, security, and reliability.

This is a full-time, remote position. Preference is for candidates to reside within 2 hours of our operational hubs (Portland, OR; Harrisburg, PA; McDonough, GA; Northlake, TX).

What You’ll Do

Technology Transformation & Leadership

Lead the enterprise Technology operating model, serving as a strategic partner to align architecture and investments with business objectives.
Drive platform modernization and strategic technical debt reduction while managing capital investments, budgets, and risk.
Establish common operating practices, governance, SLAs, and performance metrics for mission-critical services.

Software & Platform Engineering

Lead the engineering organization responsible for Vetsource's proprietary fulfillment, pharmacy, and enterprise platforms.
Deliver secure, scalable, AI-enabled platforms that accelerate innovation and business growth.
Build a high-performing engineering culture grounded in modern practices, including cloud-native architecture, DevSecOps, CI/CD, and API-first design.

Supply Chain & Fulfillment Technology

Lead the technology strategy and roadmap supporting pharmacy operations, warehouse technology, and replenishment planning.
Modernize and rearchitect proprietary fulfillment platforms for future scale, improving throughput, service levels, and cost efficiency.
Develop next-generation capabilities and workflows utilizing AI, robotics, and intelligent automation.

Finance Technology & Enterprise Platforms

Partner with Finance leadership to modernize operations through Oracle and enterprise platforms.
Ensure systems support speed, accuracy, scalability, and strong financial controls and compliance.
Provide technical leadership for Record-to-Report processes, enterprise integrations, and automation of financial reporting and reconciliation.

Associate Digital Experience

Lead workplace technology, identity management, and support functions, driving AI adoption to improve associate productivity and satisfaction.

Data, AI & Operational Intelligence

Lead cross-functional teams to improve data quality and accelerate AI adoption across supply chain, fulfillment, finance, and enterprise functions.

Reliability, Security & Operational Excellence

Ensure enterprise platforms are secure, reliable, and observable while driving a culture of service ownership and continuous improvement.

Leadership Expectations

Operate with urgency and accountability, taking ownership of outcomes over activities while driving organizational modernization.
Hire, develop, and retain high-performing technology professionals, providing actionable feedback and maintaining robust succession plans.
Build trusted partnerships across the business and foster a transparent, learning-oriented culture.
Balance technical and operational excellence with responsible risk management and continuous innovation.

Success Measures (Within first 24 months)

Modernize critical fulfillment and enterprise technology architectures to improve scalability, reliability, and delivery speed.
Accelerate the adoption of AI-driven operational workflows to improve efficiency.
Develop a high-performing leadership team with a strong succession pipeline.
Establish technology as a strategic, competitive advantage for Vetsource.

What You Bring

Undergraduate degree
15+ years leading large-scale tech organizations across software engineering, enterprise platforms, data, infrastructure, cybersecurity, cloud environments, and business transformation
10+ years of experience with Oracle Fusion Cloud, including 5+ years managing supply chain, finance, and EPM modules
Experience implementing modern API-driven technology platforms and enterprise applications (CRM, Digital Marketing, ecommerce, HCM, ERP, and custom development)
Experience incorporating AI and agentic platforms with workflow and process orchestration
Ability to create and execute a clear technology strategy, possessing exceptional business acumen, analytical, and problem-solving skills
Able to articulate complex ideas to technical and non-technical audiences, build consensus across all levels, and skillfully negotiate with internal customers and external vendors
Demonstrated ability to recruit, motivate, and retain a high-performing team rooted in transparency and accountability
A trusted, highly ethical team player who favors collaborative approaches with internal and external partners
A high-energy, low-ego executive who is comfortable with ambiguity, handles the unexpected with flexibility, and is passionate about reaching the goal

Preferred Experience And Qualifications

Experience with Google Cloud or Amazon Web Services, alongside managing as-a-service, outsourced, and cloud-based solutions.
Proven ability to build strong vendor partnerships that ensure optimal performance and financial return
Demonstrated success driving digital and business transformation through technology innovation, coupled with strong change management skills for leading complex initiatives
Highly customer-service oriented with an entrepreneurial approach, demonstrating the ability and interest to pursue new business opportunities

WORKING CONDITIONS

Reliable, remote internet access is required
Sitting/standing at a desk working on a computer for long periods of time
Must be flexible for some travel, up to 15%

What Can You Expect From Vetsource

In addition to an inclusive and welcoming culture, Vetsource also offers:

Competitive pay and benefits including medical, vision*, dental, and life insurance
Employee Assistance Program
Pet insurance* and Virtual vet care
PTO, Holidays, Floating Holidays, and Volunteer Day
Retirement Savings Plan (401k/ RRSP) with employer matching program
Paid parental leave
Flexible scheduling and remote work where possible
The opportunity to join one of our Associate Resource Groups, and fun company events!

For Canadian based associates these specific benefits are not included*

OUR VALUES

Vetsource is proud to be part of Mars Science & Diagnostics, a division of Mars Petcare—a family-owned organization rooted in the belief that pets make the world a better place. Our unified culture is built on a foundation of veterinary excellence and guided by a shared vision, inspiring everyone to create A Better World for Pets™ — a world where pets are healthy, happy, and welcome.

Today, Vetsource drives the future of pet health centered on our guiding philosophy, The Five Principles: Quality, Responsibility, Mutuality, Efficiency, and Freedom. These principles define how we work, how we treat one another, and how we serve the veterinary community, ensuring a culture where every associate has the opportunity to thrive.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Software Engineering (Protect)
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Pindrop is the Real Human + Right Human® Identity Trust Platform for the AI era. As AI-driven fraud and deepfakes erode trust in digital communication, Pindrop delivers continuous identity verification and deepfake detection across voice, video, and digital interactions in real time.

Enterprises rely on Pindrop to secure billions of high-risk customer interactions each year, including top U.S. banks, as well as leading insurers and healthcare providers. Powered by models trained on more than 1.5 billion real-world interactions annually and protected by 300+ patents, Pindrop restores trust while reducing fraud, lowering operational costs, and improving customer experience.

Recognized by TIME as one of the Top 10 Most Influential Software Companies of 2026 and by Inc. for Best in Business for Innovation, Pindrop is backed by leading investors including Andreessen Horowitz, IVP, and CapitalG.

As Senior Manager, Engineering for Protect, you will lead a critical engineering area within Pindrop's fraud detection platform. This role combines hands-on technical credibility with strong people leadership. You will help your team build and operate scalable, high-performance services that power real-time fraud detection, while partnering closely with Product, Research, and peer engineering leaders to deliver meaningful customer outcomes.

More specifically, you will:

Lead the strategy, execution, and day-to-day engineering operations for a key Protect domain, with a focus on reliability, delivery quality, and technical health.
Manage, mentor, and grow a team of engineers, building a culture of ownership, continuous improvement, and strong technical execution.
Stay close to the architecture and implementation details, moving comfortably between planning, technical design, and operational problem-solving when needed.
Partner with Product, Research, SRE, and adjacent engineering teams to prioritize work, remove bottlenecks, and deliver scalable solutions in a multi-cloud environment.
Strengthen engineering fundamentals across your area, including observability, incident response, quality practices, CI/CD, and team operating cadences.
Use data, metrics, and technical judgment to identify systemic issues, improve team effectiveness, and raise the bar on execution.

Who you are

You are a technically credible, hands-on leader who can move from strategy to architecture to day-to-day execution without losing the trust of the team.
You are collaborative and culture-driven, and you know how to energize a team while partnering effectively across functions.
You are resilient, calm under pressure, and comfortable making sound decisions in ambiguous or high-stakes situations.
You are an influential communicator who can translate technical priorities and tradeoffs into clear business impact for stakeholders.

Your skill-set

Must-haves:

6+ years of experience in software, platform, or cloud engineering, including direct responsibility for team leadership and delivery outcomes.
Strong hands-on experience building and operating distributed systems in AWS and/or GCP, with familiarity in Kubernetes, CI/CD, and cloud-native engineering practices.
Proven ability to lead engineers through execution, improve engineering processes, and deliver reliable systems in production.
Strong technical grounding in modern backend engineering, observability, and operational excellence.

Nice-to-haves:

Experience in fraud prevention, authentication, voice biometrics, trust and safety, or related security products.
Prior hands-on experience as a software, infrastructure, or platform engineer before moving into management.
Experience working in high-growth SaaS environments where speed, scale, and cross-functional execution all matter.

What's in it for you

This is a high-impact opportunity to lead meaningful Protect engineering work at the center of Pindrop's mission. Your team's work will directly influence how effectively we detect fraud in real time, how reliably our platform scales, and how quickly we can bring new capabilities to market. You will have strong visibility, real ownership, and the chance to shape both the team and the systems behind one of Pindrop's most important product areas.

What we offer

As a part of Pindrop, you'll have a direct impact on our growing list of products and the future of security in the voice-driven economy. We hire great people and take care of them. Here's a snapshot of the benefits we offer:

Competitive compensation package, including RSUs (Restricted Stock Units) for all employees, so everyone shares in our long-term success.
Remote-first environment - giving you flexibility and autonomy in how you structure your day.
While we work flexibly, we prioritize meaningful in-person moments through regular team on-sites, company-wide events, and intentional gatherings that foster connection, collaboration, and shared success.
Unlimited Paid Time Off (PTO)
Generous health and welfare plans to choose from - including one employer-paid "employee-only" plan!
Best-in-class Health Savings Account (HSA) employer contribution
Low-cost vision and dental plans for you and your family, providing comprehensive coverage and peace of mind.
Paid Parental Leave - Including birth, adoptive & foster parents
One year of diaper delivery for your newest addition to the family! It's our way of welcoming new Pindroplets to the family!

Recurring monthly phone and internet allowance to help cover essential connectivity costs and support flexible work.
Enhanced fertility and GLP-1 benefits to support family-building journeys and personalized health needs.
Annual Learning & Development stipend to support your professional growth, skill-building, certifications, and continued education.

This position will be posted for 30 days after 7/23/26.

Please note that the base pay range is a general guideline only. Pindrop considers factors such as (but not limited to) scope and responsibilities of the position, a candidate's work experience, education/training, and key skills, as well as market and business considerations, when extending an offer.

US Base Pay Range

$195,000—$235,000 USD

Not sure if this is you?

We want a diverse, global team, with a broad range of experience and perspectives. If this job sounds great, but you're not sure if you qualify, apply anyway! We carefully consider every application and will either move forward with you, find another team that might be a better fit, keep in touch for future opportunities, or thank you for your time.

AI - A Transformative Force

At Pindrop, we view artificial intelligence as a transformative force that, when harnessed responsibly, can unlock unprecedented value for our customers, partners and society and enable and empower us to continue to deliver cutting-edge technology to combat fraud and unblur the lines between what it means to be human versus machine.

Applications with the strongest match to job requirements are prioritized for human review; not all applications may be individually reviewed.

Pindrop is an Equal Opportunity Employer

Here at Pindrop, it is our mission to create and maintain a diverse and inclusive work environment. jobs.description:
Working with Us

Challenging. Meaningful. Life-changing. Those aren’t words that are usually associated with a job. But working at Bristol Myers Squibb is anything but usual. Here, uniquely interesting work happens every day, in every department. From optimizing a production line to the latest breakthroughs in cell therapy, this is work that transforms the lives of patients, and the careers of those who do it. You’ll get the chance to grow and thrive through opportunities uncommon in scale and scope, alongside high-achieving teams. Take your career farther than you thought possible.

Bristol Myers Squibb recognizes the importance of balance and flexibility in our work environment. We offer a wide variety of competitive benefits, services and programs that provide our employees with the resources to pursue their goals, both at work and in their personal lives. Read more careers.bms.com/working-with-us.

Position Responsibilities

Define and lead the AI-powered Engineering & Development across the CRM capabilities — identifying and delivering AI-enabled solutions that create measurable business value, reduce manual effort, and elevate the intelligence of commercial field tools - embedded within Veeva CRM UIX layers.
Champion an AI-first engineering mindset — embedding AI coding assistants, LLM-augmented development workflows, and automated testing into day-to-day engineering practice to accelerate delivery and raise code quality.
Drive platform simplification and intelligent automation programs — rationalizing legacy configurations, eliminating high-effort manual workflows through AI-driven orchestration, and replacing complexity with elegant, automated, and scalable solutions.
Lead agentic AI experiments and enterprise pilots — designing AI agents that autonomously manage CRM workflows, enrich data, route actions, and surface intelligent field recommendations via CRM APIs and third-party data sources.
Establish AI governance and responsible AI frameworks within CRM engineering — ensuring all AI solutions comply with BMS AI policies, data privacy regulations, explainability standards, and validated systems requirements.
Lead the end-to-end UIX strategy for Veeva CRM field-facing interfaces — including rep/manager screens, MyInsights/X-Pages, and embedded dashboards — and lead their architecture and development using HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript (ES6+), Veeva JavaScript SDK, and Java SDK.
Define and enforce UIX design standards, component libraries, and reusable UI patterns across the global CRM engineering team to ensure consistency, accessibility, and scalability.
Lead all aspects of Veeva CRM platform administration — user/territory management, security models, profiles, permission sets, role hierarchies, object configurations, workflow rules, approval processes, automation triggers, SSO, reporting/dashboard infrastructure, and data loading operations.
Govern CRM environment strategy — sandbox, UAT, staging, and production — with disciplined promotion workflows, configuration trackers, and change management controls aligned to validated systems standards.
Lead custom development initiatives using Java SDK, scripting languages (Groovy, JavaScript, Shell), and Veeva-native frameworks — delivering controllers, SDK-based logic layers, event handlers, background services, integration connectors, and a governed reusable code library.
Design and implement CRM integration solutions — RESTful/SOAP APIs, middleware connectors, event-driven pipelines, and batch data exchange workflows — connecting Veeva CRM with MDM, ERP, AI/ML services, Veeva Vault, and Salesforce.
Drive CI/CD adoption and DevOps best practices — automated deployment pipelines, environment promotion workflows, code reviews, Git-based version control, coding standards enforcement, and GxP/GCP-compliant release automation.
Lead innovation forums, hackathons, and technology showcases — fostering a culture of curiosity, experimentation, and breakthrough thinking across onshore, nearshore, and offshore engineering communities.
Set the technical vision and engineering roadmap for the CRM Administration & Development stream — aligning platform capabilities, custom development priorities, and AI/automation investments with BMS's commercial IT strategy.
Prototype and demonstrate new CRM and AI capabilities — building proof-of-concept solutions to validate feasibility, de-risk delivery, and support executive roadmap planning and investment decisions.
Drive portfolio-level technical risk management — identifying systemic risks, architectural vulnerabilities, and compliance gaps, and driving structured remediation programs across the CRM platform estate.
Lead, develop, and inspire a globally distributed team of CRM developers, administrators, UIX engineers, and AI specialists — setting technical direction, building AI and CRM competency, and fostering a high-performance, innovation-led culture across onshore, nearshore, and offshore locations.
Manage vendor & partner relationships — influencing product roadmaps, driving SLA accountability, resolving escalations, and identifying strategic partnership opportunities.
Partner with Product Owners, Commercial Business Teams, and cross-matrix IT teams (Data, AI/ML, Security, Infrastructure, Enterprise Architecture) to translate strategic business needs into scalable, AI-enabled CRM solutions with clear value outcomes.
Drive global delivery governance — facilitating agile ceremonies, maintaining program-level transparency, and ensuring cross-geo delivery cadence, milestone predictability, and audit-ready delivery artifacts at all times.
Communicate risks, issues, and delivery impacts to senior management with actionable strategies, contingency plans, and executive-ready status narratives.

Requirements

Required

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a related field.
9+ years of overall IT experience in CRM software development, platform administration, and enterprise solution delivery — with demonstrated experience in senior technical leadership roles.
5+ years of hands-on Veeva CRM experience — with deep expertise across platform administration, UIX/MyInsights/X-Pages development, custom development (Java SDK, scripting), security models, profiles, objects, controllers, workflows, SSO, permission sets, reports, dashboards, data loading, and integrations.
3+ years of hands-on custom development experience using Java, Java SDK (Veeva), JavaScript, or equivalent scripting languages within CRM or enterprise application environments.
1+ years of applied AI/ML, intelligent automation, or Generative AI experience — including designing, building, or operationalizing AI-enabled solutions within enterprise CRM or field technology environments.
4+ years of experience with SDLC methodologies (Agile and Waterfall), validated and regulated system delivery in the life sciences domain, and cloud-native application development.
Demonstrated experience designing and implementing CRM integrations using REST/SOAP APIs, middleware, or event-driven architectures.
Demonstrated experience leading globally distributed engineering teams — including onshore, nearshore, and offshore delivery models.
At least 2 active relevant technical certifications.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, written, and verbal communication skills — with a proven ability of presenting to leadership and cross-functional technical audiences.

Additionally Preferred

Deep expertise in Life Science CRM capabilities - Account management, affiliations, MyInsights/X-Pages, product metrics, MCCP, sampling, Approved Email, Engage, territory management, media content, Call/eMIRF, suggestions, surveys, iRep configurations, Event Managements and integrations.
Experience integrating CRM with AI/ML platforms and services — surfacing predictive model outputs, next-best-action, or intelligent insights within CRM UIX layers.
Experience with CI/CD tooling (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, Jenkins) for automated CRM configuration deployment and SDK build pipelines.
Familiarity with master data management (MDM) processes relevant to CRM data governance — HCP/HCO data, territory hierarchies, and product catalog management.

jobs.title: Senior Manager of Data Science Production Engineering, DevOps
jobs.description:
This is an exciting opportunity to lead a DevOps team at Natera, a global leader in precision medicine and genomics testing. As a Senior Manager of the DevOps team inside our Data Science Production Engineering (DSPE) department, you will have the opportunity to work with Natera's diverse and ultra-large data sets (up to PB size), build upon the latest information and cloud technologies, create solutions for the most cutting-edge medical diagnostics and genomics applications, and make real impact by delivering reliable, efficient, high performance data/cloud/automation systems to support Natera's Lab Operations and Genetic Counselor/Lab Director teams, and ultimately impact patients' medical outcomes.

Primary Responsibilities

Leadership

Lead a DevOps team, working closely with other DSPE teams, to develop, test, deploy, maintain, and update DSPE's data platforms, cloud platforms, automation systems, and analytics systems
Manage the DevOps team, to achieve the timely and efficient delivery of software products and systems with correct and robust functionality.
Train and coach team members on new technologies, procedures, and guidelines/best practices.
Create and maintain operational visibility (e.g., workload, productivity, etc.) of the DSPE DevOps team.

Technical

Translate DSPE's business needs and project requirements into technical specifications and implementation plans.
Working with DSPE leadership teams, create suitable system architecture and infrastructure design documents that can be efficiently implemented and maintained.
Maintain and optimize infrastructure performance, monitoring key system metrics including network I/O, disk I/O, memory allocation, and compute resource utilization.
Contribute to key development, testing, deployment, validation, maintenance, and update activities.

Quality, Compliance, and Documentation

Improve and enforce procedures for work efficiency, quality, and compliance.
Lead and manage the technical documentation's creation and maintenance/update for all DSPE DevOps owned software tools and systems, for example, design specifications, software verification and validation (V&V) protocols and reports, deployment/update/maintenance records, user guides, etc.
Create training materials, and contribute to training activities, on DSPE DevOps owned software tools and systems.

Cross-Functional

Engage proactively and directly with engineering and operational stakeholders to align infrastructure roadmaps, resolve technical dependencies, and report platform performance metrics.
Represent the DSPE DevOps team in stakeholder meetings.

Qualifications

Minimal Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Bioinformatics, or a related field. Advanced degrees preferred.
Minimal 10 years of relevant industry experience for candidates with only a Bachelor's Degree. Minimal 8 years of relevant industry experience for candidates with a Master's Degree. Minimal 4 years of relevant industry experience for candidates with a Doctorate degree.
Minimal 3 years of working experience in a highly regulated environment, e.g., CLIA and/or FDA compliant settings.
Minimal 3 years of management experience leading a DevOps team, or a software development team.
Demonstrable experience in designing, delivering, and maintaining/updating custom-developed software tools or systems for production environments, preferable in high-throughput settings (e.g., heavy traffic and/or high computation load).
Demonstrable experience in creating software design specification documents, verification and validation documents, and user manuals.

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

Excellent Python programming skills, with substantial cloud application and/or automation system development experience.
Proficient with RDBMS systems such as PostgreSQL and/or MySQL, and substantial working experience in for-production database-based application development.
Working knowledge in optimizing system architecture and individual components for performance, scalability, and/or reliability.
Proficiency in tool/system performance evaluation methods, and in-depth understanding of key factors, such as RAM, Disk IO, Network IO's impact on system/tool's performance.
Proficiency with AWS, and substantial working experience in developing for-production software tools/systems using AWS services.
Proficiency in SDLC and software development and testing methodologies.
Proficient Linux command line skills, and past Linux application development experience.
Past experience and working knowledge in genomics and bioinformatics technologies.
Good understanding and past working experience with genomics data, such as FASTQ, BAM, VCF files.
Proficiency in Git workflow and version control systems like GitHub and/or GitLab.
Past experience in developing automation solutions.

Good documentation practices and coding style.
Strong verbal and written communication skills.
Strong interpersonal skills.
Strong integrity.
Team player.

jobs.title: VP, Data Products & Platform Lead
jobs.description:
About The Role

We are hiring the founding lead for data products and platform: a senior, hands-on builder who will own how the firm defines, governs, and ships its core investment data, and who will grow a small team around them. You will sit at the center of a federated model — every desk, from portfolio management and trading to portfolio administration, finance, research, and compliance, already builds with our data. Your job is to turn that energy into trusted, shared, and governed products rather than fragmented private workarounds. This is a player-coach role: you will set product direction, write production code, and hire and lead as the function grows.

Responsibilities

Data Product & Governance

Stand up the firm's first real intake, prioritization, and roadmap for data work — replacing ad-hoc triage with a visible, defensible backlog.
Learn how each function uses the same data, then reconcile divergent definitions into a single set of canonical, documented entities — fund and security master, holdings, classifications, corporate actions, index data — that the firm trusts and reuses.
Own the data-product lifecycle: turn recurring needs into governed shared products with clear ownership, SLAs, and a catalog that makes the canonical layer discoverable.
Drive adoption, measured by the number of teams using the shared layer instead of querying raw vendor tables.

Hands-on Engineering & Delivery

Build and ship. Write production dbt models in Python and SQL, and design the serving and semantic layers. You are expected to be in the codebase, not only the roadmap.
Harden the platform: alerting on data freshness and pipeline runs, workload isolation, least-privilege service accounts, and managed, monitored ingestion.
Partner on the market data and internal reporting build and the Bloomberg / FactSet data consolidation already underway; make the canonical layer the obvious, safe starting point for AI-assisted building across the firm.

Leadership & Team-building

Build and lead a small, senior data team; mentor existing engineers and the embedded analysts across the business.
Establish the operating model — shared repository, review and approval workflow, standards — with the central team as reviewer and enabler, not gatekeeper.
Be the firm's senior voice on data, translating fluently between business stakeholders, compliance, and engineering.

Qualifications

8+ years in data, with a genuine blend of hands-on data engineering and data-product ownership — you have both shipped pipelines and models and owned definitions and roadmaps.
Deep buy-side / asset-management data domain: security and fund master, holdings, transactions, corporate actions, benchmarks and index constituents, identifiers, and NAV — plus the vendor feeds behind them (Bloomberg, FactSet, fund-accountant data).
Expert SQL and Python; production experience with Snowflake and dbt (or close equivalents).
Demonstrated ownership of a canonical data model or data standards across multiple consuming teams.
A track record of building and leading a small data team — or clear, evidenced readiness to step into a founding-lead role.
Strong written and verbal communication; able to set definitions and defend prioritization with executives and compliance.
ETF / 1940-Act fund experience; familiarity with SEC recordkeeping (Rule 204-2), Regulation S-P, 15(c) board reporting, and the Tailored Shareholder Reports regime.
Modern-stack depth: data catalog (e.g., OpenMetadata, Atlan), orchestration (Airflow / MWAA), managed ingestion, BI (Sigma), Snowflake Cortex and semantic views.
Hands-on with AI-assisted engineering (e.g., Claude Code, Codex, Kiro) and with building self-serve, semantic, or agent layers over governed data.
AWS and Terraform / infrastructure-as-code; experience standing up data governance in a regulated environment.

Our Stack

Snowflake, dbt, Sigma, MWAA / Airflow, AWS (S3, Lambda), GitHub Enterprise, Terraform; Bloomberg and FactSet; Okta for identity; and Claude Enterprise, Claude Code, Kiro, and AWS Bedrock for AI-assisted engineering.

Compensation Range

$220,000-$230,000 plus annual bonus

Global X does not accept unsolicited resumes or candidate profiles from recruitment agencies, search firms, or third-party recruiters.

Compensation & Benefits

Global X offers a competitive total compensation package, including base salary, annual performance bonus, and a comprehensive benefits program:

Competitive base salary with annual performance-based bonus
Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance
401(k) retirement plan with company matching
Generous paid time off and company holidays
Professional development and continuing education opportunities
Hybrid work flexibility
Life and disability insurance
Wellness programs and employee assistance program (EAP)

About Global X

Global X was founded in 2008. For more than fifteen years, our mission has been empowering investors with unexplored and intelligent solutions. Our product lineup features a wide range of ETF strategies and $78.1 billion in assets under management. While we are distinguished for our Thematic Growth, Income, and International Access ETFs, we also offer Core and other funds to suit a wide range of investment objectives. Explore our ETFs, research and insights, and more atwww.globalxetfs.com.

Global X is a member of Mirae Asset Financial Group (“Mirae Asset”), a global leader in financial services, with $803 billion in assets under management worldwide. Mirae Asset has an extensive global ETF platform ranging across the U.S., Australia, Brazil, Canada, Colombia, Europe, Hong Kong, India, Japan, Korea, and Vietnam.

jobs.title: Director of Operational Excellence Engineering
jobs.description:
The Director of Operational Excellence Engineering will serve as a strategic individual contributor responsible for driving operational excellence and system reliability across B2C retirement platforms. Reporting directly to the Head Retirement Solutions Individual Technology (B2C), this role is essential to achieving our Executive Committee mandate to make 2026 the year of operational excellence, with particular focus on serving our top institutions, TRAC users, and participants.

This position will function as the Technology lead for B2C operational excellence initiatives, working in close partnership with the Retirement Technology Operations & Managed Services organization to establish unified standards and practices across service delivery functions. The role brings critical parity to our operating model, mirroring a parallel position being established for B2B operations.

Key Responsibilities And Duties

Operational Excellence & Root Cause Analysis – Conduct comprehensive analysis of system performance, service incidents, and outage patterns to identify systemic issues and their underlying causes. Synthesize data from incident reports, monitoring systems, and operational metrics to pinpoint areas where structural improvements will yield the greatest impact on system reliability and participant experience. Develop holistic remediation strategies that address root problems rather than symptoms.
Site Reliability Engineering & System Resilience – Champion Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) principles and practices to build more resilient systems. Identify opportunities to implement graceful degradation patterns, ensuring systems maintain core functionality even during partial failures. Evaluate current architecture and operational practices to recommend and drive implementation of fail-safe mechanisms, redundancy strategies, and automated recovery procedures that minimize participant impact during system stress or component failures.
Zero Tolerance Compliance & Monitoring – Establish and maintain rigorous monitoring frameworks and early warning systems in support of our zero tolerance posture for system outages. Define key performance indicators, establish escalation protocols, and ensure real-time visibility into system health across all B2C platforms. Develop proactive intervention strategies that prevent incidents before they impact participants.
Managed Services Oversight & SLA Management – Serve as the primary oversight lead for our Accenture managed services partnership, ensuring contractual service level agreements are consistently met for all B2C operations. Track service delivery metrics, conduct regular performance reviews, identify gaps in service delivery, and drive accountability for remediation. Maintain detailed scorecards and documentation that demonstrate compliance and highlight areas requiring attention.
Executive Reporting & Communication – Develop and deliver regular executive-level reporting on operational excellence initiatives, system reliability metrics, incident trends, and program progress. Create dashboards, presentations, and written reports that clearly communicate both technical and business impacts of operational improvements. Translate complex technical information into business outcomes that resonate with EC-level stakeholders.
Cross-Functional Partnership & Synergy Building – Work collaboratively with Retirement Technology Operations & Managed Services leadership to identify opportunities to create operational synergies, eliminate redundancies, and establish consistent practices across service delivery functions. Ensure alignment between development, operations, and managed services teams in pursuit of common operational excellence goals.

Qualifications

15+ years of experience in B2B enterprise technology marketing, including leadership in platform, AI, cloud, data, or digital transformation solutions.

Exceptional messaging and positioning capabilities, with evidence of simplifying complex technologies.

Technical fluency and intellectual curiosity in relevant technology domains.

jobs.title: VP of Engineering
jobs.description:
Counterpart believes in small businesses and is dedicated to helping them do more with less risk. By pairing leading insurance experts with cutting-edge technology, Counterpart empowers small business owners to grow with confidence. Exceptional underwriters, trusted insurance brokers, and prominent insurance carriers come together on the Counterpart platform to support small businesses by providing AI-driven management and professional liability underwriting and claims services. That's where you come in…

Counterpart is building the first AI-native insurance company. We are redesigning how we operate from the ground up so that every person carries real context, real ownership, and real leverage, and the system carries the rest. As VP of Engineering, you will lead our flat-by-design engineering organization. Scaling our impact through better infrastructure, better context systems, and agents that compound every engineer's output. You will own the technical vision, engineering operations, and people strategy for the function, and you will represent Counterpart's technology strategy to the board.

As VP of Engineering, you will:

Evolve how our flat engineering organization scales with agents. Ensure and retain high talent density. Drive efficiency by leveraging AI. Set the forward-looking technical vision that supports the business.
Shape how Counterpart builds software in an AI-native world. Partner with the CEO, engineering leaders, and technical product managers to refine how we build, how we operate, and how we compound output.
Run Engineering as a function that allocates its people and agents across competing initiatives. Own the allocation decisions, engineering standards, delivery quality, and the mechanisms to ensure project teams maintain technical coherence while operating independently.
Own the infrastructure that enables AI-native engineering: developer experience, AI and data platforms, and system infrastructure.
Own hiring, performance management, compensation, and talent development for the engineering organization. Partner with the Head of People and the Chief of Staff to ensure Engineering's people model and operations fit the company's operating cadence.
Ensure our systems meet high standards for reliability, observability, and security, including compliance with SOC 2, HIPAA, and NYC Cybersecurity regulations.
Represent Counterpart's technology capabilities internally and externally, aligning with leadership, partners, and investors to communicate vision and execution.

YOU HAVE:

12+ years of engineering leadership, with experience leading engineering organizations through multiple company-stage transitions. You have operated at a scale that regularly required engagement with the board, investors, and executive leadership. You know what great engineering organizations look like at each stage and what structures break when the company outgrows them.
A strong point of view on what AI-native engineering looks like. Not just using AI tools. You have thought deeply about how AI changes the role of the engineer, the shape of the engineering org, and the economics of software delivery. You hold opinions on where the industry is going, and you can defend them. You also know where the hype outpaces reality.
Deep technical fluency to form strong opinions on system architecture, AI and data infrastructure, and deployment pipelines.
Customer empathy and product sense. You think about business and technology together, never one at the expense of the other. You constantly look for ways to enable the business through technology: building new capabilities while improving the systems underneath. You do not refactor for refactoring's sake, and you do not ship features on a foundation that cannot support them.
Experience leading fully distributed teams with high trust and high accountability.
Experience in regulated industries (insurance, fintech, healthcare, or similar) is a strong plus. You understand that compliance (SOC 2, HIPAA, state cybersecurity regulations) is a constraint you build into systems, not an afterthought you bolt on.
