jobs.title: Vice President, Technology
jobs.description:
Pets deserve the best care. At Vetsource, we build the foundation for success, enabling those in the pet healthcare profession and industry to thrive. Our data-powered platform simplifies processes and streamlines systems, helping those we serve create tighter bonds with their customers. From prescription management and pet owner engagement to veterinary business performance data and insights, Vetsource provides comprehensive solutions that give our customers more time and flexibility, and help them foster strong relationships and positive experiences. In a rapidly evolving world, we’re constantly seeking new ways to help our customers chart a course for a better, brighter future for pets and those who care for them.

If you love pets, want to have an impact and join a fantastic organization, Vetsource could be the place for you.

At Vetsource, our teams, much like our customers, are represented through diverse perspectives, life experiences, unique strengths (and love for animals). We are an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace.

We are a team of real people looking for great people to join us, which is why applications are carefully and thoughtfully reviewed by our team. We know that when considering a new opportunity, it's common to weigh your qualifications against the listed job criteria. That said, even if you don’t meet 100% of the job requirements but feel you would be a good fit for the role, we still encourage you to apply!

Who We Are Looking For

Vice President, Technology

The Vice President, Technology is a senior technology executive responsible for leading software engineering and enterprise technology, delivering the platforms, systems, and capabilities that power Vetsource's operations and enable the company's next phase of growth. Reporting to the Chief Technology Officer, this leader oversees the technology platforms supporting pharmacy operations, supply chain, finance, workplace technology, and enterprise operations while driving modernization, automation, and AI adoption across the business.

A key responsibility of this role is the evolution of Vetsource's proprietary fulfillment and operational technology platforms into a strategic competitive advantage. This includes defining and executing the next generation fulfillment architecture leveraging AI, robotics, intelligent workflow orchestration, and automation to create a scalable competitive advantage for Vetsource.

This executive partners closely with leaders across the business to shape the technology strategy and roadmap to advance our mission to deliver personalized care for pets while improving operational speed, reliability, scalability, and cost efficiency.

Beyond technology delivery, this leader will build high-performing teams, develop organizational capabilities, and drive transformation with a new operating model that accelerates innovation while maintaining operational excellence, security, and reliability.

This is a full-time, remote position. Preference is for candidates to reside within 2 hours of our operational hubs (Portland, OR; Harrisburg, PA; McDonough, GA; Northlake, TX).

What You’ll Do

Technology Transformation & Leadership

Lead the enterprise Technology operating model, serving as a strategic partner to align architecture and investments with business objectives.
Drive platform modernization and strategic technical debt reduction while managing capital investments, budgets, and risk.
Establish common operating practices, governance, SLAs, and performance metrics for mission-critical services.

Software & Platform Engineering

Lead the engineering organization responsible for Vetsource's proprietary fulfillment, pharmacy, and enterprise platforms.
Deliver secure, scalable, AI-enabled platforms that accelerate innovation and business growth.
Build a high-performing engineering culture grounded in modern practices, including cloud-native architecture, DevSecOps, CI/CD, and API-first design.

Supply Chain & Fulfillment Technology

Lead the technology strategy and roadmap supporting pharmacy operations, warehouse technology, and replenishment planning.
Modernize and rearchitect proprietary fulfillment platforms for future scale, improving throughput, service levels, and cost efficiency.
Develop next-generation capabilities and workflows utilizing AI, robotics, and intelligent automation.

Finance Technology & Enterprise Platforms

Partner with Finance leadership to modernize operations through Oracle and enterprise platforms.
Ensure systems support speed, accuracy, scalability, and strong financial controls and compliance.
Provide technical leadership for Record-to-Report processes, enterprise integrations, and automation of financial reporting and reconciliation.

Associate Digital Experience

Lead workplace technology, identity management, and support functions, driving AI adoption to improve associate productivity and satisfaction.

Data, AI & Operational Intelligence

Lead cross-functional teams to improve data quality and accelerate AI adoption across supply chain, fulfillment, finance, and enterprise functions.

Reliability, Security & Operational Excellence

Ensure enterprise platforms are secure, reliable, and observable while driving a culture of service ownership and continuous improvement.

Leadership Expectations

Operate with urgency and accountability, taking ownership of outcomes over activities while driving organizational modernization.
Hire, develop, and retain high-performing technology professionals, providing actionable feedback and maintaining robust succession plans.
Build trusted partnerships across the business and foster a transparent, learning-oriented culture.
Balance technical and operational excellence with responsible risk management and continuous innovation.

Success Measures (Within first 24 months)

Modernize critical fulfillment and enterprise technology architectures to improve scalability, reliability, and delivery speed.
Accelerate the adoption of AI-driven operational workflows to improve efficiency.
Develop a high-performing leadership team with a strong succession pipeline.
Establish technology as a strategic, competitive advantage for Vetsource.

What You Bring

Undergraduate degree
15+ years leading large-scale tech organizations across software engineering, enterprise platforms, data, infrastructure, cybersecurity, cloud environments, and business transformation
10+ years of experience with Oracle Fusion Cloud, including 5+ years managing supply chain, finance, and EPM modules
Experience implementing modern API-driven technology platforms and enterprise applications (CRM, Digital Marketing, ecommerce, HCM, ERP, and custom development)
Experience incorporating AI and agentic platforms with workflow and process orchestration
Ability to create and execute a clear technology strategy, possessing exceptional business acumen, analytical, and problem-solving skills
Able to articulate complex ideas to technical and non-technical audiences, build consensus across all levels, and skillfully negotiate with internal customers and external vendors
Demonstrated ability to recruit, motivate, and retain a high-performing team rooted in transparency and accountability
A trusted, highly ethical team player who favors collaborative approaches with internal and external partners
A high-energy, low-ego executive who is comfortable with ambiguity, handles the unexpected with flexibility, and is passionate about reaching the goal

Preferred Experience And Qualifications

Experience with Google Cloud or Amazon Web Services, alongside managing as-a-service, outsourced, and cloud-based solutions.
Proven ability to build strong vendor partnerships that ensure optimal performance and financial return
Demonstrated success driving digital and business transformation through technology innovation, coupled with strong change management skills for leading complex initiatives
Highly customer-service oriented with an entrepreneurial approach, demonstrating the ability and interest to pursue new business opportunities

WORKING CONDITIONS

Reliable, remote internet access is required
Sitting/standing at a desk working on a computer for long periods of time
Must be flexible for some travel, up to 15%

What Can You Expect From Vetsource

In addition to an inclusive and welcoming culture, Vetsource also offers:

Competitive pay and benefits including medical, vision*, dental, and life insurance
Employee Assistance Program
Pet insurance* and Virtual vet care
PTO, Holidays, Floating Holidays, and Volunteer Day
Retirement Savings Plan (401k/ RRSP) with employer matching program
Paid parental leave
Flexible scheduling and remote work where possible
The opportunity to join one of our Associate Resource Groups, and fun company events!

For Canadian based associates these specific benefits are not included*

OUR VALUES

Vetsource is proud to be part of Mars Science & Diagnostics, a division of Mars Petcare—a family-owned organization rooted in the belief that pets make the world a better place. Our unified culture is built on a foundation of veterinary excellence and guided by a shared vision, inspiring everyone to create A Better World for Pets™ — a world where pets are healthy, happy, and welcome.

Today, Vetsource drives the future of pet health centered on our guiding philosophy, The Five Principles: Quality, Responsibility, Mutuality, Efficiency, and Freedom. These principles define how we work, how we treat one another, and how we serve the veterinary community, ensuring a culture where every associate has the opportunity to thrive.

jobs.title: Director of Engineering
jobs.description:
Remote [within the US]

About The Role

The Engineering Director is responsible for leading large-scale engineering initiatives across multiple teams, ensuring that the engineering function aligns with the company’s overall business strategy. This role requires a strong blend of technical expertise, leadership ability, and strategic thinking. The Engineering Director oversees complex projects, manages senior engineering talent, and drives innovation to ensure that the company's technical solutions are industry-leading. In this role you will also play a key part in working with senior leadership to shape the company’s long-term technical vision while guiding the organization through an agentic AI transition.

Your work will directly impact the security posture of organizations protecting their most valuable AI assets, from financial institutions and healthcare systems to government agencies and Fortune 500 enterprises.

Who We Are

HiddenLayer protects the world’s most valuable technologies from adversarial AI attacks. We were founded by AI professionals and security specialists with first-hand experience of how insidious adversarial AI attacks can be to detect and defend against. Determined to prove that these attacks were preventable, the team developed a unique, patent-pending, productized solution to support organizations in accelerating their adoption of AI securely.

Our dedication to innovation has been recognized by prestigious awards such as RSA's Innovation Sandbox Winner, CB Insights AI 100, CyberTech 100, and SC's Most Promising Early-Stage Start-up.

What You’ll Do

Engineering Leadership & Oversight: Oversee the performance and output of multiple engineering teams, ensuring that projects are executed effectively and align with company goals. Provide guidance and mentorship to engineering managers and senior technical staff.
Strategic Planning & Vision: Collaborate with the VP of Engineering and other senior leaders to develop the engineering strategy and roadmap. Shepherd our systems and processes through our ongoing agentic transformation.
Project Management & Execution: Manage large-scale, complex engineering projects, ensuring they are delivered on time, within scope, and with high quality. Oversee project prioritization, resource allocation, and risk management.
Technical Innovation & Excellence: Drive innovation in technology and processes with a focus on agentic loop engineering, ensuring that the company remains competitive and up-to-date with the latest developments in software and system architecture. Foster a culture of continuous improvement and technical excellence.
Cross-Departmental Collaboration: Partner with product management, design, operations, and other departments to ensure cohesive execution of business strategies. Act as the engineering liaison with other business units, ensuring that technical solutions meet business needs.
Team Development & Mentorship: Build, scale, and develop engineering talent. Provide mentorship to engineering directors and other senior technical staff, ensuring they grow in leadership and technical expertise.
Performance Metrics & Reporting: Establish and track key performance indicators (KPIs) for engineering teams. Regularly report on progress, performance, and issues to senior leadership.
Process Optimization: Continuously evaluate and optimize engineering workflows, development processes, and tools to increase efficiency and productivity. Implement best practices in agile development, software quality assurance, and deployment pipelines.
Risk Management & Problem Solving: Identify potential technical risks and work proactively to mitigate them. Provide solutions for complex technical challenges and ensure that engineering projects stay on course.

Who You Are

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field; Master’s degree preferred.
10+ years of experience in software engineering or related technical roles, with 5+ years in leadership positions, preferably at the director or senior manager level.

jobs.title: Data Engineering Manager, Sr
jobs.description:
Overview

Old National Bank has been serving clients and communities since 1834. With over $70 billion in total assets, we are a regional powerhouse deeply rooted in the communities we serve. As a trusted partner, we thrive on helping our clients achieve their goals and dreams, and we are committed to social responsibility and investing in our communities through volunteering and charitable giving.

We continually seek highly motivated and talented individuals as our people are critical to our success. In return, we offer competitive compensation with our salary and incentive program, in addition to medical, dental, and vision insurance. 401K, continuing education opportunities and an employee assistance program are also included in our benefit suite. Old National also offers a variety of Impact Network Groups led by team members who are passionate about driving engagement, creating awareness of diverse backgrounds and experiences, and building inclusion across the organization. We offer a unique opportunity to join a growing, community and client-focused company that is firmly rooted in its core values.

Responsibilities

The Senior Data Engineering Manager leads a data engineering team within the Data Technology organization, overseeing the development and delivery of technical solutions that support the bank's data strategy. This leader sets vision and direction for their team's domain, ensures alignment with the Data Office and stakeholders across the bank and IT, and collaborates with other product owners and managers to deliver customer value. The Senior Data Engineering Manager guides and mentors data engineers, fosters a culture of innovation and excellence, and promotes best practices in data engineering and agile methodologies. This role reports to the Chief Data Technology Officer and works closely with the Enterprise Architecture, Info Security, and Data Governance organizations.

Salary Range

The salary range for this position is $98,400/yr - $199,000/yr plus bonus. The base salary indicated for this position reflects the compensation range applicable to all levels of the role across the United States. Actual salary offers within this range may vary based on a number of factors, including the specific responsibilities of the position, the candidate’s relevant skills and professional experience, educational qualifications, and geographic location.

Key Accountabilities

Key Accountability 1: Technical Leadership & Delivery

Serve as the technical leader for the team's domain, providing architectural direction and ensuring technical excellence.
Collaborate with product owners, managers, and stakeholders to define and deliver data solutions that drive customer value.
Oversee design, development, testing, deployment, and maintenance of data products, platforms, or services within the team's scope.
Ensure quality, reliability, scalability, and security of delivered solutions.
Establish and enforce data engineering standards, best practices, and guidelines.
Ensure compliance with enterprise data architecture and governance frameworks.
Monitor, troubleshoot, and resolve data and technical issues within the team's domain.
Provide technical guidance, mentorship, and coaching to data engineers.
Foster a culture of innovation and excellence.
Position may require travel to other branch or meeting locations.

Key Accountability 2: Team Management & Strategic Direction

Lead and manage the data engineering team including hiring, onboarding, performance management, career development, and retention.
Define and communicate the team's vision, roadmap, and backlog in alignment with the Data Technology organization's strategy.
Ensure alignment with the Data Office and other stakeholders across the bank.
Provide technical guidance, mentorship, and coaching to develop team capabilities.
Foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and excellence.
Define and execute a data engineering strategy supporting the bank's data vision and goals.
Align with enterprise data architecture and governance frameworks.

Key Accountability 3: Solution Development & Operational Excellence

Manage end-to-end delivery of data solutions, from ideation to deployment and ongoing support.
Apply agile and lean principles and practices (Scrum, Kanban).
Establish and enforce standards, best practices, and guidelines within the team's domain.
Ensure compliance with enterprise data architecture and governance frameworks.
Drive operational excellence through monitoring, issue resolution, and continuous improvement.
Ensure data quality and security across all team deliverables.

Key Accountability 4: Forward Thinking & Leadership Communications

Stay abreast of latest trends and technologies in data engineering, cloud platforms, and the team's domain area.
Evaluate and recommend new solutions , tools, and approaches.
Demonstrate technical passion and curiosity to explore and adopt new technologies .
Prepare and present data engineering reports, dashboards, and metrics to senior leadership and business partners.

Key Competencies for Position

Develops Talent - Advocates for talent development as an organizational imperative and develops people according to talent strategy needs cultivating a diverse succession “pipeline ” . Continuously assesses talent across the bank to develop an understanding of capabilities and potential and leverages talent as a corporate resource to meet needs today and into the future . Cultivates an environment of trust and optimizes others' talents and capabilities across the organization, driving a culture of continuous coaching and feedback . Retains, attracts and recruits top diverse talent leveraging opportunistic hires to meet current and future people needs at Old National .
Promotes Change - Explains the business need, impact, and anticipated benefits of the change while engaging stakeholders to gain buy-in. Shapes and transforms culture by building an organizational culture of change agility. Manages risk associated with the change through appropriate contingency planning . Promotes change where it is needed to stay relevant and successful while creating conditions for team members to creatively generate new ways to enhance Old National's ability to succeed .
Strategy in Action - Develops, communicates, and aligns organization with a clear vision and strategy empowering team members to take action . Maintains a strong network of advisors and leverages resources to stay current on emerging trends and market factors that may influence ONB’s strategy. Envisions how Old National's responses to trends may impact our longer-term vision and strategy while formulating a clear strategy that will accelerate ONB towards its strategic goals . Challenges the status quo to develop new ways of thinking encouraging curiosity beyond the current state . Conveys opportunities to realize the organization’s purpose, strategy, and culture in a way that captures attention, arouses emotion and compels others to act despite obstacles .
Compelling Communication - Conveys transparent messages logically, simply, succinctly and at the right pace while being in command of the message. Captivates audience through compelling language tailored to the audience’s expectations and communication style. Checks for understanding and presents messages in different ways to enhance receiver’s understanding. Listens and objectively considers others’ ideas and perspectives while encouraging others to do the same while addressing negative reactions to others’ ideas that jeopardize this open exchange.
Makes Decisions & Solves Problems - Analyzes, contrasts, combines and compares data to define the most relevant organizational problems and opportunities and gain clarity on potential impact. Creates sound strategies by gathering information through listening, deep questions, challenging assumptions and collaborating with networks in and outside of Old National. Aligns efforts and resources around blue chips and formulates decisions on relevant factors (e.g., costs, benefits, buy-in, risks) with the greatest potential for positive impact. Sets strategic direction for short-and long-term goals while remaining agile to adjust plans to close current gaps, modifying priorities as circumstances change.
Delights Clients - Cultivates an environment where team members passionately serve internal/external clients with excellence. Promotes a growth mindset culture by keeping current with development and trends in industry and sharing information to build knowledge base of organization and net promotor score. Understands data, metrics and/or financial information and how they tie to clients, business outcomes, organization and industry . Empowers a culture of accountability across the organization where all team members nurture client relationships by listening, prioritizing, and acting responsibly to meet client needs, mitigate risk and add shareholder value .
Leads Inclusively - Advocates the value of diversity as a competitive advantage and initiates and champions inclusive recruiting and development processes that challenge the status quo, when necessary, to increase diversity in the workplace. Sets up outreach systems and processes that seek ideas, opinions, and insights from diverse sources and while optimizing effectiveness by aligning individuals’ unique talents, interests and abilities with the most relevant roles and responsibilities . Thinks with an inclusive lens promotes inclusion by actively leading DEI initiatives while encouraging all team members to engage in DEI experiences . Demonstrates self-awareness , admits mistakes and seeks feedback from all levels within Old National while acknowledging and challenging bias (conscious and unconscious) and exclusionary behavior .
Personifies ONB Culture - Instills confidence in one’s actions and outcomes consistent with Old National's culture. Promotes the organization’s vision, strategy, and values while recognizing behavior that supports the vision and values. Conveys opportunities to realize the organization’s purpose, strategy, and culture in a way that captures attention, arouses emotion and compels others to take action despite obstacles. Inspires others to personally contribute to the organization’s success for the long term by investing time, heart, and expertise to help clients and communities thrive.

Q Ualifications And Education Requirements

Education and Experience

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science , Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field, or equivalent work experience.
8+ years data Engineering (ETL/ELT, data pipelines, data lakes, data warehouses, and data integration solutions)
3+ years managing and leading data engineering teams (financial services/banking preferred)
3+ years cloud data platforms (e.g., Azure Databricks, Data Factory, Data Lake Storage, Synapse Analytics, or equivalent)
3+ years technical product owner/product manager for data products, platforms, or solutions using Scrum or Kanba n

Technical Skills

Expertise in building scalable, reliable, and secure data solutions using modern data engineering approaches (metadata-driven, event-driven, and API-driven).
Experience working with stakeholders on gathering requirements, defining user stories, and translating business needs into data solutions, with a focus on developing reusable and modular components.
Experience in scripting tools such as Python, C#, or PowerShell.
Experience in orchestration tools or job schedulers, such as Azure Data Factory, Airflow, or equivalent.
Experience in data modeling, data quality, data governance, and data security standards and best practices.
Experience in code repositories and version control tools such as Azure DevOps, Git, etc.
Experience in analytical and data visualization tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or equivalent.
Strong T-SQL proficiency including complex stored procedures, user-defined functions, and query optimization.

jobs.description:
The next part of your journey is right around the corner — with The Standard.

A genuine desire to make a difference in the lives of others is the foundation for everything we do. With a customer-first mindset and an intentional focus on building strong teams, we’ve been able to uphold our legacy of financial stability while investing in new, innovative technologies that support the needs of our customers. Our high-performance culture focused on operational excellence thrives thanks to remarkable people united by compassion and a customer-first commitment. Are you ready to make a difference?

Job Summary

The Director, Data & AI Platform Engineering leads the engineering strategy, development, delivery, and operational excellence of the enterprise Data & AI Platform. This role combines enterprise technology leadership with the development of high-performing engineering teams spanning data engineering, software engineering, AI/ML platform engineering, DevOps, DevSecOps, DataOps, MLOps, and LLMOps.

Working closely with Product, Architecture, Governance, Security, Risk, Enterprise Delivery, Analytics & BI, and AI Product teams, the Director delivers a governed, reusable, self-service platform foundation. This leader is responsible for engineering execution across Foundational Data & AI Products, Integration & Runtime, and the Shared Substrate, with capabilities designed to be defined once, governed once, and consumed by many.

Key Responsibilities:

Engineering Leadership and Team Development

Lead and develop multidisciplinary engineering teams while building a culture of ownership, collaboration, engineering excellence, and continuous improvement.

Coach engineering managers, technical leads, architects, and senior engineers; build succession plans and strengthen leadership capacity.
Lead workforce planning, hiring, onboarding, performance management, capability development, and talent retention.
Establish clear accountability and decision-making across distributed teams and engineering disciplines.

Platform Engineering Strategy and Delivery

Set and execute the engineering strategy for the shared Data & AI Platform in partnership with platform product leadership and architecture.

Deliver platform-managed capabilities across Foundational Data & AI Products, Integration & Runtime, and Shared Substrate.
Guide engineering investment in canonical data products, the governed context foundation, model and tool gateways, registries, agent runtime, APIs, lakehouse, catalog, compute, storage, and golden-path automation.
Balance near-term delivery with platform sustainability, reuse, scalability, and the thin-platform boundary.

Operational Excellence and Governance

Ensure platform services are reliable, secure, observable, supportable, and operated to published service objectives.

Establish engineering standards for architecture, CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code, automated testing, observability, incident response, resilience, documentation, and operational readiness.
Partner with Governance, Security, Risk, and Architecture so policy is technically enforced while architecture pattern-setting remains distinct from policy ownership.
Use delivery, reliability, quality, contract-conformance, adoption, and consumer-feedback measures to drive continuous improvement.

Enterprise Partnership and Execution

Build strong partnerships across business, data, AI, product, architecture, governance, and enterprise technology organizations.

Communicate engineering priorities, delivery progress, operational health, risks, dependencies, and outcomes to senior stakeholders.
Enable self-service golden paths so consumers can build compliant solutions without embedding or waiting on the platform team.
Manage capacity, vendors, dependencies, and organizational scaling in alignment with the platform roadmap.

Skills And Background You’ll Need

Education:
A Bachelor’s degree is required.

Experience:
Minimum 8 – 10 years’ experience within IT and 3+ years’ experience managing IT employees

Demonstrated experience leading enterprise-scale data, technology, platform, product, or analytics organizations and developing high-performing teams.
Strong strategic planning, prioritization, communication, stakeholder partnership, and organizational change leadership skills.
Experience operating in a regulated environment with governance, security, privacy, audit, risk, and access-control expectations.

Driving Success: Demonstrates energy and persistence when tackling complex challenges and views difficult problems as opportunities to create value.
Winning Together: Builds trust and strong working relationships across teams, values diverse perspectives, and fosters collaboration to achieve shared objectives.
Strategic Visioning: Considers future scenarios, opportunities, and risks to develop thoughtful recommendations that align with the company's long-term strategic objectives.

Why Join The Standard?

We have built an enduring legacy of stability, financial strength and exceptional customer service through the contributions of the service-oriented people who choose to work at The Standard. To ensure we can attract and retain the best talent, when you join The Standard you can expect:

A rich benefits package including medical, dental, vision and a 401(k) plan with matching company contributions

Our data-powered platform simplifies processes and streamlines systems, helping those we serve create tighter bonds with their customers. From prescription management and pet owner engagement to veterinary business performance data and insights, Vetsource provides comprehensive solutions that give our customers more time and flexibility, and help them foster strong relationships and positive experiences. In a rapidly evolving world, we’re constantly seeking new ways to help our customers chart a course for a better, brighter future for pets and those who care for them.

If you love pets, want to have an impact and join a fantastic organization, Vetsource could be the place for you.

At Vetsource, our teams, much like our customers, are represented through diverse perspectives, life experiences, unique strengths (and love for animals). We are an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace.

We are a team of real people looking for great people to join us, which is why applications are carefully and thoughtfully reviewed by our team. We know that when considering a new opportunity, it's common to weigh your qualifications against the listed job criteria. That said, even if you don’t meet 100% of the job requirements but feel you would be a good fit for the role, we still encourage you to apply!

Who We Are Looking For

Vice President, Technology

The Vice President, Technology is a senior technology executive responsible for leading software engineering and enterprise technology, delivering the platforms, systems, and capabilities that power Vetsource's operations and enable the company's next phase of growth. Reporting to the Chief Technology Officer, this leader oversees the technology platforms supporting pharmacy operations, supply chain, finance, workplace technology, and enterprise operations while driving modernization, automation, and AI adoption across the business.

A key responsibility of this role is the evolution of Vetsource's proprietary fulfillment and operational technology platforms into a strategic competitive advantage. This includes defining and executing the next generation fulfillment architecture leveraging AI, robotics, intelligent workflow orchestration, and automation to create a scalable competitive advantage for Vetsource.

This executive partners closely with leaders across the business to shape the technology strategy and roadmap to advance our mission to deliver personalized care for pets while improving operational speed, reliability, scalability, and cost efficiency.

Beyond technology delivery, this leader will build high-performing teams, develop organizational capabilities, and drive transformation with a new operating model that accelerates innovation while maintaining operational excellence, security, and reliability.

This is a full-time, remote position. Preference is for candidates to reside within 2 hours of our operational hubs (Portland, OR; Harrisburg, PA; McDonough, GA; Northlake, TX).

What You’ll Do

Technology Transformation & Leadership

Lead the enterprise Technology operating model, serving as a strategic partner to align architecture and investments with business objectives.
Drive platform modernization and strategic technical debt reduction while managing capital investments, budgets, and risk.
Establish common operating practices, governance, SLAs, and performance metrics for mission-critical services.

Software & Platform Engineering

Lead the engineering organization responsible for Vetsource's proprietary fulfillment, pharmacy, and enterprise platforms.
Deliver secure, scalable, AI-enabled platforms that accelerate innovation and business growth.
Build a high-performing engineering culture grounded in modern practices, including cloud-native architecture, DevSecOps, CI/CD, and API-first design.

Supply Chain & Fulfillment Technology

Lead the technology strategy and roadmap supporting pharmacy operations, warehouse technology, and replenishment planning.
Modernize and rearchitect proprietary fulfillment platforms for future scale, improving throughput, service levels, and cost efficiency.
Develop next-generation capabilities and workflows utilizing AI, robotics, and intelligent automation.

Finance Technology & Enterprise Platforms

Partner with Finance leadership to modernize operations through Oracle and enterprise platforms.
Ensure systems support speed, accuracy, scalability, and strong financial controls and compliance.
Provide technical leadership for Record-to-Report processes, enterprise integrations, and automation of financial reporting and reconciliation.

Associate Digital Experience

Lead workplace technology, identity management, and support functions, driving AI adoption to improve associate productivity and satisfaction.

Data, AI & Operational Intelligence

Lead cross-functional teams to improve data quality and accelerate AI adoption across supply chain, fulfillment, finance, and enterprise functions.

Reliability, Security & Operational Excellence

Ensure enterprise platforms are secure, reliable, and observable while driving a culture of service ownership and continuous improvement.

Leadership Expectations

Operate with urgency and accountability, taking ownership of outcomes over activities while driving organizational modernization.
Hire, develop, and retain high-performing technology professionals, providing actionable feedback and maintaining robust succession plans.
Build trusted partnerships across the business and foster a transparent, learning-oriented culture.
Balance technical and operational excellence with responsible risk management and continuous innovation.

Success Measures (Within first 24 months)

Modernize critical fulfillment and enterprise technology architectures to improve scalability, reliability, and delivery speed.
Accelerate the adoption of AI-driven operational workflows to improve efficiency.
Develop a high-performing leadership team with a strong succession pipeline.
Establish technology as a strategic, competitive advantage for Vetsource.

What You Bring

Undergraduate degree
15+ years leading large-scale tech organizations across software engineering, enterprise platforms, data, infrastructure, cybersecurity, cloud environments, and business transformation
10+ years of experience with Oracle Fusion Cloud, including 5+ years managing supply chain, finance, and EPM modules
Experience implementing modern API-driven technology platforms and enterprise applications (CRM, Digital Marketing, ecommerce, HCM, ERP, and custom development)
Experience incorporating AI and agentic platforms with workflow and process orchestration
Ability to create and execute a clear technology strategy, possessing exceptional business acumen, analytical, and problem-solving skills
Able to articulate complex ideas to technical and non-technical audiences, build consensus across all levels, and skillfully negotiate with internal customers and external vendors
Demonstrated ability to recruit, motivate, and retain a high-performing team rooted in transparency and accountability
A trusted, highly ethical team player who favors collaborative approaches with internal and external partners
A high-energy, low-ego executive who is comfortable with ambiguity, handles the unexpected with flexibility, and is passionate about reaching the goal

Preferred Experience And Qualifications

Experience with Google Cloud or Amazon Web Services, alongside managing as-a-service, outsourced, and cloud-based solutions.
Proven ability to build strong vendor partnerships that ensure optimal performance and financial return
Demonstrated success driving digital and business transformation through technology innovation, coupled with strong change management skills for leading complex initiatives
Highly customer-service oriented with an entrepreneurial approach, demonstrating the ability and interest to pursue new business opportunities

WORKING CONDITIONS

Reliable, remote internet access is required
Sitting/standing at a desk working on a computer for long periods of time
Must be flexible for some travel, up to 15%

What Can You Expect From Vetsource

In addition to an inclusive and welcoming culture, Vetsource also offers:

Competitive pay and benefits including medical, vision*, dental, and life insurance
Employee Assistance Program
Pet insurance* and Virtual vet care
PTO, Holidays, Floating Holidays, and Volunteer Day
Retirement Savings Plan (401k/ RRSP) with employer matching program
Paid parental leave
Flexible scheduling and remote work where possible
The opportunity to join one of our Associate Resource Groups, and fun company events!

For Canadian based associates these specific benefits are not included*

OUR VALUES

Vetsource is proud to be part of Mars Science & Diagnostics, a division of Mars Petcare—a family-owned organization rooted in the belief that pets make the world a better place. Our unified culture is built on a foundation of veterinary excellence and guided by a shared vision, inspiring everyone to create A Better World for Pets™ — a world where pets are healthy, happy, and welcome.

Today, Vetsource drives the future of pet health centered on our guiding philosophy, The Five Principles: Quality, Responsibility, Mutuality, Efficiency, and Freedom. These principles define how we work, how we treat one another, and how we serve the veterinary community, ensuring a culture where every associate has the opportunity to thrive.

jobs.title: Data Engineering Manager, Sr
jobs.description:
Overview

Old National Bank has been serving clients and communities since 1834. With over $70 billion in total assets, we are a regional powerhouse deeply rooted in the communities we serve. As a trusted partner, we thrive on helping our clients achieve their goals and dreams, and we are committed to social responsibility and investing in our communities through volunteering and charitable giving.

We continually seek highly motivated and talented individuals as our people are critical to our success. In return, we offer competitive compensation with our salary and incentive program, in addition to medical, dental, and vision insurance. 401K, continuing education opportunities and an employee assistance program are also included in our benefit suite. Old National also offers a variety of Impact Network Groups led by team members who are passionate about driving engagement, creating awareness of diverse backgrounds and experiences, and building inclusion across the organization. We offer a unique opportunity to join a growing, community and client-focused company that is firmly rooted in its core values.

Responsibilities

The Senior Data Engineering Manager leads a data engineering team within the Data Technology organization, overseeing the development and delivery of technical solutions that support the bank's data strategy. This leader sets vision and direction for their team's domain, ensures alignment with the Data Office and stakeholders across the bank and IT, and collaborates with other product owners and managers to deliver customer value. The Senior Data Engineering Manager guides and mentors data engineers, fosters a culture of innovation and excellence, and promotes best practices in data engineering and agile methodologies. This role reports to the Chief Data Technology Officer and works closely with the Enterprise Architecture, Info Security, and Data Governance organizations.

Salary Range

The salary range for this position is $98,400/yr - $199,000/yr plus bonus. The base salary indicated for this position reflects the compensation range applicable to all levels of the role across the United States. Actual salary offers within this range may vary based on a number of factors, including the specific responsibilities of the position, the candidate’s relevant skills and professional experience, educational qualifications, and geographic location.

Key Accountabilities

Key Accountability 1: Technical Leadership & Delivery

Serve as the technical leader for the team's domain, providing architectural direction and ensuring technical excellence.
Collaborate with product owners, managers, and stakeholders to define and deliver data solutions that drive customer value.
Oversee design, development, testing, deployment, and maintenance of data products, platforms, or services within the team's scope.
Ensure quality, reliability, scalability, and security of delivered solutions.
Establish and enforce data engineering standards, best practices, and guidelines.
Ensure compliance with enterprise data architecture and governance frameworks.
Monitor, troubleshoot, and resolve data and technical issues within the team's domain.
Provide technical guidance, mentorship, and coaching to data engineers.
Foster a culture of innovation and excellence.
Position may require travel to other branch or meeting locations.

Key Accountability 2: Team Management & Strategic Direction

Lead and manage the data engineering team including hiring, onboarding, performance management, career development, and retention.
Define and communicate the team's vision, roadmap, and backlog in alignment with the Data Technology organization's strategy.
Ensure alignment with the Data Office and other stakeholders across the bank.
Provide technical guidance, mentorship, and coaching to develop team capabilities.
Foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and excellence.
Define and execute a data engineering strategy supporting the bank's data vision and goals.
Align with enterprise data architecture and governance frameworks.

Key Accountability 3: Solution Development & Operational Excellence

Manage end-to-end delivery of data solutions, from ideation to deployment and ongoing support.
Apply agile and lean principles and practices (Scrum, Kanban).
Establish and enforce standards, best practices, and guidelines within the team's domain.
Ensure compliance with enterprise data architecture and governance frameworks.
Drive operational excellence through monitoring, issue resolution, and continuous improvement.
Ensure data quality and security across all team deliverables.

Key Accountability 4: Forward Thinking & Leadership Communications

Stay abreast of latest trends and technologies in data engineering, cloud platforms, and the team's domain area.
Evaluate and recommend new solutions , tools, and approaches.
Demonstrate technical passion and curiosity to explore and adopt new technologies .
Prepare and present data engineering reports, dashboards, and metrics to senior leadership and business partners.

Key Competencies for Position

Develops Talent - Advocates for talent development as an organizational imperative and develops people according to talent strategy needs cultivating a diverse succession “pipeline ” . Continuously assesses talent across the bank to develop an understanding of capabilities and potential and leverages talent as a corporate resource to meet needs today and into the future . Cultivates an environment of trust and optimizes others' talents and capabilities across the organization, driving a culture of continuous coaching and feedback . Retains, attracts and recruits top diverse talent leveraging opportunistic hires to meet current and future people needs at Old National .
Promotes Change - Explains the business need, impact, and anticipated benefits of the change while engaging stakeholders to gain buy-in. Shapes and transforms culture by building an organizational culture of change agility. Manages risk associated with the change through appropriate contingency planning . Promotes change where it is needed to stay relevant and successful while creating conditions for team members to creatively generate new ways to enhance Old National's ability to succeed .
Strategy in Action - Develops, communicates, and aligns organization with a clear vision and strategy empowering team members to take action . Maintains a strong network of advisors and leverages resources to stay current on emerging trends and market factors that may influence ONB’s strategy. Envisions how Old National's responses to trends may impact our longer-term vision and strategy while formulating a clear strategy that will accelerate ONB towards its strategic goals . Challenges the status quo to develop new ways of thinking encouraging curiosity beyond the current state . Conveys opportunities to realize the organization’s purpose, strategy, and culture in a way that captures attention, arouses emotion and compels others to act despite obstacles .
Compelling Communication - Conveys transparent messages logically, simply, succinctly and at the right pace while being in command of the message. Captivates audience through compelling language tailored to the audience’s expectations and communication style. Checks for understanding and presents messages in different ways to enhance receiver’s understanding. Listens and objectively considers others’ ideas and perspectives while encouraging others to do the same while addressing negative reactions to others’ ideas that jeopardize this open exchange.
Makes Decisions & Solves Problems - Analyzes, contrasts, combines and compares data to define the most relevant organizational problems and opportunities and gain clarity on potential impact. Creates sound strategies by gathering information through listening, deep questions, challenging assumptions and collaborating with networks in and outside of Old National. Aligns efforts and resources around blue chips and formulates decisions on relevant factors (e.g., costs, benefits, buy-in, risks) with the greatest potential for positive impact. Sets strategic direction for short-and long-term goals while remaining agile to adjust plans to close current gaps, modifying priorities as circumstances change.
Delights Clients - Cultivates an environment where team members passionately serve internal/external clients with excellence. Promotes a growth mindset culture by keeping current with development and trends in industry and sharing information to build knowledge base of organization and net promotor score. Understands data, metrics and/or financial information and how they tie to clients, business outcomes, organization and industry . Empowers a culture of accountability across the organization where all team members nurture client relationships by listening, prioritizing, and acting responsibly to meet client needs, mitigate risk and add shareholder value .
Leads Inclusively - Advocates the value of diversity as a competitive advantage and initiates and champions inclusive recruiting and development processes that challenge the status quo, when necessary, to increase diversity in the workplace. Sets up outreach systems and processes that seek ideas, opinions, and insights from diverse sources and while optimizing effectiveness by aligning individuals’ unique talents, interests and abilities with the most relevant roles and responsibilities . Thinks with an inclusive lens promotes inclusion by actively leading DEI initiatives while encouraging all team members to engage in DEI experiences . Demonstrates self-awareness , admits mistakes and seeks feedback from all levels within Old National while acknowledging and challenging bias (conscious and unconscious) and exclusionary behavior .
Personifies ONB Culture - Instills confidence in one’s actions and outcomes consistent with Old National's culture. Promotes the organization’s vision, strategy, and values while recognizing behavior that supports the vision and values. Conveys opportunities to realize the organization’s purpose, strategy, and culture in a way that captures attention, arouses emotion and compels others to take action despite obstacles. Inspires others to personally contribute to the organization’s success for the long term by investing time, heart, and expertise to help clients and communities thrive.

Q Ualifications And Education Requirements

Education and Experience

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science , Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field, or equivalent work experience.
8+ years data Engineering (ETL/ELT, data pipelines, data lakes, data warehouses, and data integration solutions)
3+ years managing and leading data engineering teams (financial services/banking preferred)
3+ years cloud data platforms (e.g., Azure Databricks, Data Factory, Data Lake Storage, Synapse Analytics, or equivalent)
3+ years technical product owner/product manager for data products, platforms, or solutions using Scrum or Kanba n

Technical Skills

Expertise in building scalable, reliable, and secure data solutions using modern data engineering approaches (metadata-driven, event-driven, and API-driven).
Experience working with stakeholders on gathering requirements, defining user stories, and translating business needs into data solutions, with a focus on developing reusable and modular components.
Experience in scripting tools such as Python, C#, or PowerShell.
Experience in orchestration tools or job schedulers, such as Azure Data Factory, Airflow, or equivalent.
Experience in data modeling, data quality, data governance, and data security standards and best practices.
Experience in code repositories and version control tools such as Azure DevOps, Git, etc.
Experience in analytical and data visualization tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or equivalent.
Strong T-SQL proficiency including complex stored procedures, user-defined functions, and query optimization.

jobs.title: HEAD OF INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY (IT)
jobs.description:
Industry:
Microfinance Banking | Financial Services

Location:
Obanikoro, Lagos

Employment Type:
Full-Time

Reports To:
Managing Director / Executive Management

Monthly Salary:
₦450,000 Gross

Experience:
5–8 Years

About The Role

Our client, a reputable Microfinance Bank
, is seeking an experienced and results-driven Head of Information Technology (IT)
to provide strategic, operational, and technical leadership for the Bank's technology function.

The successful candidate will be responsible for the overall management of the Bank's IT infrastructure, BankOne Core Banking Application
, information security, cybersecurity, digital banking channels, systems availability, technology operations, business continuity, and IT regulatory compliance.

The ideal candidate must have hands-on experience working with BankOne within a banking environment
, with a strong understanding of core banking operations, infrastructure management, cybersecurity, systems administration, and technology risk.

The successful candidate will ensure that the Bank's technology environment remains secure, resilient, reliable, scalable, and compliant
with applicable Central Bank of Nigeria (CBN)
requirements, the Nigeria Data Protection Act (NDPA)
, and other relevant regulatory and industry standards.

Key Responsibilities

1. IT Strategy & Leadership

Develop and execute the Bank's IT strategy in alignment with business objectives, operational requirements, and regulatory expectations.
Provide strategic and operational leadership across IT infrastructure, applications, cybersecurity, digital platforms, and technology operations.
Develop, implement, and maintain IT policies, procedures, standards, and operating frameworks.
Lead technology improvement and digital transformation initiatives across the Bank.
Provide technology advisory support to Management and other business functions.
Lead, supervise, and develop the IT team to ensure effective service delivery and accountability.

2. BankOne Core Banking Application Management

Take primary responsibility for the administration, support, performance, and availability of the BankOne Core Banking Application.
Monitor BankOne operations and ensure timely resolution or escalation of application-related issues.
Manage user access, roles, privileges, configurations, and system controls within BankOne.
Coordinate BankOne upgrades, patches, integrations, configurations, and system enhancements.
Liaise with BankOne support teams, vendors, and service providers for technical support and issue resolution.
Ensure appropriate change management, access control, audit trails, and system documentation are maintained.
Support business users in the effective utilisation of BankOne and related banking applications.

3. IT Infrastructure & Operations

Oversee the Bank's IT infrastructure, including servers, networks, databases, endpoints, internet connectivity, communication systems, and related technology platforms.
Ensure high availability, reliability, performance, and security of critical IT systems.
Monitor system uptime, capacity, performance, and infrastructure health.
Coordinate preventive maintenance, patch management, system upgrades, backups, and technology refresh initiatives.
Ensure effective technical support for the Head Office, branches, and other business locations.
Maintain an accurate inventory of IT assets, systems, licences, and technology infrastructure.

4. Information Security & Cybersecurity

Develop and maintain appropriate information security and cybersecurity controls across the Bank.
Protect the Bank's systems, applications, networks, and data against cyber threats and unauthorised access.
Manage access controls, authentication, user privileges, endpoint security, and security monitoring.
Identify, assess, and mitigate IT and cybersecurity risks.
Coordinate vulnerability assessments, security reviews, penetration testing, and remediation activities where applicable.
Lead the response to cybersecurity incidents and ensure appropriate incident documentation and escalation.
Promote cybersecurity awareness and responsible technology usage across the organisation.

5. Business Continuity & Disaster Recovery

Develop, maintain, and periodically test the Bank's IT Business Continuity and Disaster Recovery Plans.
Ensure appropriate backup, recovery, redundancy, and system resilience mechanisms are implemented.
Establish and monitor appropriate recovery objectives for critical banking systems.
Coordinate disaster recovery testing, document results, and implement required remediation actions.
Ensure critical systems can be restored within agreed recovery timelines following an incident or disruption.

6. Regulatory Compliance, IT Risk & Audit

Ensure IT operations comply with applicable CBN guidelines and regulatory requirements relating to information technology, cybersecurity, electronic banking, outsourcing, and business continuity.
Ensure compliance with the Nigeria Data Protection Act (NDPA) and applicable data protection requirements.
Support internal and external audits, regulatory examinations, technology assessments, and compliance reviews.
Maintain appropriate IT policies, registers, risk assessments, controls, procedures, and supporting evidence.
Track and close IT audit findings and regulatory observations within agreed timelines.
Prepare periodic IT risk, compliance, performance, and systems reports for Management and relevant governance committees.

7. Digital Banking & Systems Integration

Oversee the availability, performance, security, and integration of digital banking platforms and electronic channels.
Support the integration of BankOne with payment platforms, third-party applications, digital channels, and other business systems.
Identify technology opportunities that improve customer experience, operational efficiency, and service delivery.
Lead or support implementation of new technology solutions and digital initiatives.
Ensure appropriate security, testing, documentation, and change management for technology integrations.

8. Vendor & Service Provider Management

Manage relationships with IT vendors, BankOne support teams, software providers, internet service providers, technology partners, and other service providers.
Monitor vendor performance against agreed service-level agreements.
Coordinate escalation and resolution of critical technical and service issues.
Review technology solutions and vendor proposals based on reliability, security, scalability, and cost effectiveness.
Maintain appropriate records of IT contracts, licences, warranties, and service agreements.

9. IT Governance, Budget & Reporting

Establish effective IT governance, controls, processes, and performance monitoring mechanisms.
Prepare and present periodic IT performance reports to Management and the Board or relevant committees.
Develop and monitor the IT budget and ensure effective utilisation of technology resources.
Monitor IT expenditure and recommend cost-effective technology investments.
Ensure appropriate segregation of duties, access controls, approvals, and accountability within the IT function.
Maintain comprehensive documentation of IT systems, policies, infrastructure, risks, incidents, and technology assets.

KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS (KPIs)

Success in the role will be measured by:

High availability and reliability of critical banking systems.
Effective performance and uptime of the BankOne Core Banking Application.
Timely resolution of critical IT incidents and service disruptions.
Effective implementation of cybersecurity and information security controls.
Successful disaster recovery and business continuity testing.
Compliance with CBN, NDPA, audit, and other applicable regulatory requirements.
Timely closure of IT audit and regulatory findings.
Effective management of IT vendors and service-level agreements.
Successful implementation of approved technology and digital projects.
Improved IT operational efficiency and user satisfaction.
Accurate and timely IT reporting to Management and relevant governance bodies.

Qualifications & Requirements

Education

Bachelor's Degree or HND in Computer Science, Information Technology, Computer Engineering, or a related discipline.
A relevant postgraduate qualification will be an added advantage.

Professional Experience

Minimum of 5 years and up to 8 years of relevant IT experience.
At least 3 years' experience in an IT supervisory or management capacity.
Must have proven professional experience working with BankOne within a banking environment.
Previous experience in a Microfinance Bank, commercial bank, fintech, or other regulated financial institution is mandatory.
Strong hands-on experience in BankOne administration, support, configuration, user management, troubleshooting, and systems integration.
Proven experience managing IT infrastructure, networks, servers, databases, cybersecurity, and digital banking technologies.
Demonstrated understanding of banking technology operations, IT controls, risk management, and regulatory compliance.

Professional Certifications

Relevant certifications such as:

CISA
CISSP
CCNA
MCSE
ITIL
PMP

or other recognised IT, cybersecurity, infrastructure, governance, or project management certifications will be an added advantage.

Required Technical & Professional Skills

Network Administration
Server Administration
Database Management

Digital Banking Platforms
IT Risk Management
Business Continuity & Disaster Recovery
IT Governance & Controls
Data Protection & Privacy
Systems Integration
Incident & Problem Management
IT Vendor Management
IT Project Management
Regulatory & Audit Compliance
Technology Strategy & Digital Transformation

Team Leadership & People Management
Analytical and Problem-Solving Skills

jobs.title: Director, Software Engineering
jobs.description:
Overview

Who we are

Collaborative. Respectful. A place to dream and do. These are just a few words that describe what life is like at Toyota. As one of the world’s most admired brands, Toyota is growing and leading the future of mobility through innovative, high-quality solutions designed to enhance lives and delight those we serve. We’re looking for talented team members who want to Dream. Do. Grow. with us.

An important part of the Toyota family is Toyota Financial Services (TFS), the finance and insurance brand for Toyota and Lexus in North America. While TFS is a separate business entity, it is an essential part of this world-changing company- delivering on Toyota's vision to move people beyond what's possible. At TFS, you will help create best-in-class customer experience in an innovative, collaborative environment.

Toyota does not offer support or sponsorship of job applicants for employment-based visas or any other work authorization for this role now or in the future. You must have the right to work in the United States and not require Toyota support or sponsorship for immigration-related employment (e.g., H-1B, O-1, E-3, H-1B1, TN, F-1 OPT, F-1 STEM OPT, F-1 CPT, ‘job flexibility benefits’ [also known as I-140 or Adjustment of Status portability], etc.) now or in the future. You should not apply for this role if you will require Toyota to assist with immigration support or sponsorship now or in the future.

Who We’re Looking For

The TFS Enterprise Shared Service team is seeking a highly motivated person to fill an opening as a Director Software Engineering
to help our growing Enterprise Shared Services needs.

The Director Software Engineering is a pivotal leadership role responsible for overseeing all technology-related initiatives for TFS's Enterprise Shared Services and frameworks. This role entails developing and executing the technology strategy to ensure alignment with overarching business objectives. The Director of Software Engineering
must leverage their technical expertise to drive innovation and deliver impactful business outcomes. Additionally, they should possess strong influencing skills to shape strategy and forge partnerships both internally and externally collaborating with Technology Domain Owners (TDOs), Enterprise Architecture, Data Domain Owners (DDOs), and Business Domain Owners (BDOs).

What You’ll Be Doing

Leadership and Team Management:

Lead and mentor a team of engineers, fostering a culture of collaboration, innovation, and excellence.
Provide guidance, support, and coaching to team members to ensure individual and team goals are met.
Manage performance evaluations, career development, and succession planning for the team.

Technology Strategy And Execution

Develop and implement a strategic roadmap for technology initiatives to deliver industry leading real time platform and tools that can be leveraged for cloud based distributed systems, AI/ML, critical workflows, enabling seamless communication across systems for customer notifications, servicing updates, and operational events.
Implement advanced solutions using technologies like Kafka, AWS MQ, and other distributed systems to support real-time communication at scale.
Collaborate with stakeholders to understand business requirements and translate them into technology solutions that enhance employee experience.
Stay abreast of industry trends and emerging technologies to continuously improve and innovate our technology offerings.

Vendor Management And Partnerships

Manage relationships with technology vendors and service providers, ensuring alignment with organizational goals and objectives.
Evaluate vendor performance, negotiate contracts, and drive value-added partnerships to support our technology initiatives.

What You Bring

12+ years of expertise as a software engineering leader with experience in designing and implementing modern 12 factor cloud native business technology solutions.
10+ years practical knowledge of cloud platforms, Proven credentials and certification in cloud technologies
10+ years practical knowledge of advanced software design patterns & architecture (Domain Driven Design, Simple Design...) and devops
3+ years of experience with real-time event-driven, microservice architecture using Kafka and related technologies.
5+ years of proficiency in Java, Spring Framework (Spring Batch, Spring Integration), streaming technologies (like kafka) and microservices architecture.
Demonstrated experience building and managing production grade systems covering operational readiness, security, efficiency and other Non-Functional Requirements.
5+ years of direct management experience, with a proven history of acting as change agent for the company.
Demonstrated experience building a high performing team whose function requires cross company collaboration, has enterprise-wide reach, or is strategically critical to the business.
Proven track record of delivering scalable cloud native solutions by developing frameworks for addressing cross cutting concerns like logging, application testing and application security and instrumentation leveraging programming languages like Java, Python, SQL, and a variety of AWS tools and services.
Strong communication skills with the ability to move seamlessly between conversing with engineers or frontline ops employees and leading presentations with non-technical stakeholders.
A passion for staying on top of tech trends, experimenting with and learning new technologies, participating in internal & external technology communities, mentoring other members of the engineering community, and from time to time, be asked to code or evaluate code. 

Added bonus if you have

Master's degree in computer science or a master's degree in software engineering 
Previous experience successfully delivering shared services, frameworks or other reusable services at enterprise scale.

What We’ll Bring

During your interview process, our team can fill you in on all the details of our industry-leading benefits and career development opportunities. A few highlights include:

A work environment built on teamwork, flexibility, and respect
Professional growth and development programs to help advance your career, as well as tuition reimbursement
Team Member Vehicle Purchase Discount
Toyota Team Member Lease Vehicle Program (if applicable)
Comprehensive health care and wellness plans for your entire family
Toyota 401(k) Savings Plan featuring a company match, as well as an annual retirement contribution from Toyota regardless of whether you contribute (if applicable)
Paid holidays and paid time off
Referral services related to prenatal services, adoption, childcare, schools and more
Tax Advantaged Accounts (Health Savings Account, Health Care FSA, Dependent Care FSA)
Relocation assistance (if applicable)

new_jobs.title: Director of Engineering
new_jobs.description:
Prismatic is the integration platform that helps B2B software companies build integrations fast and deliver them at scale. We're turning integrations from a bottleneck into a growth driver for hundreds of companies, from high-growth startups to Fortune 500s.

Our platform handles everything that breaks at scale, so teams can ship integrations, not infrastructure. It provides flexible, AI-enabled build experiences through code-native, low-code, and an embedded workflow builder, plus self-service configuration and an embedded marketplace.

Prismatic is well-funded with strong product-market fit and a high-agency, driven, collaborative culture.

About the role:

We're hiring a Director of Engineering to lead the Engineering organization. This role reports directly to the CTO and is the single engineering leader across two teams currently totaling 8 engineers, with a plan towards ~12. This is not a manager-of-managers role today, you'll be directly managing the team. The ideal candidate is someone excited to directly lead a team of high performing Senior+ Engineers. Beyond the people management side, you'll own the full scope of execution: process, feature delivery, quality, while maintaining a highly engaged group of people.

Prismatic is built primarily in TypeScript (both frontend and backend), with some Python and Django on the backend and React on the frontend. We build a sophisticated low-code integration builder, an SDK and tools for building integrations fully in TypeScript, and features powering our customers' AI agent functionality. All of this on top of a high-scale, performance critical platform. While this is not a hands-on building role, being confident in the technology, and the challenges of a scaling a developer facing SaaS platform will be crucial to high quality decision making.

What will you do:

Partner with Product to drive execution across all initiatives; on-time delivery, quality and consistency.
Manage, coach, and grow all engineers directly, regular 1:1s, high-quality feedback, and growth conversations.
Staff each initiative and pair it with the right Tech Lead; develop the Tech Lead bench so ownership keeps spreading.
Surface and resolve cross-initiative risks: staffing gaps, priority collisions, delivery delays.
Contribute to hiring: help us find, close, and ramp the next several engineers.
Contribute technically where it helps, this isn't day-to-day code, but helping with architecture review, tech-debt analysis, scaling challenges, etc.

About you:

Demonstrated progression from a technical role to a leadership role, with demonstrated experience managing multiple teams of Engineers in a fully remote environment.
You've operated as the senior-most engineering leader in a group, or close to it; comfortable being the only manager, without a layer beneath you.
Significant technical experience in at least one area of our stack; able to speak credibly in architecture and scoping conversations.
Proven partner to Product on scope, estimation, and delivery commitments.
Experience managing remote teams; excellent written communication
Thrives on accountability, bias to action, strong desire to empower individuals and win as a team.
Experience at a scaling SaaS startup in varying roles.

Bonus if you have experience with/in:

AI-enabled software development
Developer-facing products
High scale SaaS platforms

Our tech stack:

Cloud - AWS
Databases - Postgres, Redis
Backend API - Python & Django
Backend Integration Platform - Typescript
Frontend - Typescript & React
SDKs - Typescript

Pay range:

The pay range for this role is $220,000 - $250,000/yr, plus equity
Most new hires start near the midpoint based on their relevant experience, skills, and qualifications, with room to grow within the range over time.

Life at Prismatic

Our Values

Our values shape everything we do—how we make decisions, collaborate, and operate day to day.

Give a Shit
– We bring passion and drive to our work. We believe what we're doing matters and we treat it that way.
Progress Over Perfection
– We value daily progress, moving fast, and iterating. We prefer a good solution now over a perfect one later.
Same Team
– We recognize that we succeed or fail as a group and help each other out. We don't tolerate assholes.

What to expect at Prismatic

We operate with urgency, ownership, and high standards. You'll be joining a team that's highly engaged, customer-obsessed, and constantly solving new problems that help B2B software companies scale their integration strategies.

To support this pace, we're also intentional about sustainability. We offer comprehensive benefits, unlimited PTO, and top-tier equipment for remote work.

Benefits

🏡 Remote work:
Our team works remotely across the US; we travel together 2x times a year for company kick-offs and mid-year meetings.

🏖️ Unlimited PTO:
We have an unlimited & flexible paid time off (PTO) policy that encourages our team to recharge when they need to.

🏥 Medical, dental & vision:
Prismatic offers high-quality medical (Cigna Medical), dental (Guardian Dental) and vision (Guardian VSP) care for full-time employees and their dependents.

🛡️ Life insurance:
We provide company-paid life insurance, short-term disability insurance, and long-term disability insurance through Guardian.

🏦 401(k):
Our 401(k) plan is through Empower with 4% company match - 100% of the first 3% and 50% of the next 2%.

💻 Computer & technology equipment:
We provide the equipment you need to do your best work, applicable to your role + $1k new hire setup stipend.

Ready to Help Turn Integrations Into Growth Drivers?

We want diverse perspectives and experiences. If this role excites you but you're not sure you check every box, apply anyway. We consider every application thoughtfully and will either move forward with you, connect you with another team that might be a better fit, or keep in touch for future opportunities.

You will work closely with silicon architects, hardware design teams, AI framework, product management, ecosystem partners, and key customers to define and deliver differentiated platform capabilities that maximize hardware performance/efficiency as well as developer productivity.

This role leads a high-performing architecture organization responsible for defining scalable system architectures, driving technology strategy, and ensuring architectural consistency across multiple products, programs, domains, and engineering verticals.

They can operate effectively in a matrixed environment, influence senior stakeholders, align cross-functional teams, and translate long-term architecture vision into executable roadmaps.

They are passionate about developing technical leaders, building strong ownership models, and driving architecture-led execution across complex product stacks.

Key Responsibilities

Own and drive architecture strategy, governance, and technical execution for the AMD Instinct Stack across RAS, System Software, Security, Platform Management, Diagnostics, Telemetry, and future platform technologies, while leading a highly functional organization of architects and domain experts operating across multiple engineering verticals and product generations.

Define and own the long-term architecture strategy and roadmap for AMD Instinct stack architecture across multiple domains.
Drive architectural alignment across RAS, System Software, Security, Platform Management, Diagnostics, Telemetry, Manageability, Infrastructure, and future platform technologies.

Build, lead, and develop a high-performing team of architects, technical leaders, and domain experts across multiple verticals.
Establish clear ownership, accountability, operating mechanisms, and execution discipline across architecture domains.
Partner with silicon architecture, system architecture, firmware, software, validation, product management, customer engineering, and executive leadership.
Serve as a primary architecture interface for senior leadership, cross-functional teams, and strategic customers.
Drive product roadmap influence, technology investment recommendations, risk management, and platform simplification.
Champion innovation, design reuse, platform consistency, and scalable architectural approaches across AMD datacenter products.

Deep expertise in datacenter GPU, AI accelerator, HPC, large-scale system architecture, or platform architecture.
Experience spanning hardware, firmware, system software, security, reliability, diagnostics, platform management, and customer enablement.
Proven experience leading architecture teams supporting complex GPU, CPU, SoC, accelerator, or rack-scale platform programs.
Demonstrated success influencing executives and senior technical leaders in a highly matrixed engineering environment.
Strong understanding of RAS, telemetry, serviceability, manageability, resiliency, security, and system-level performance tradeoffs.
Track record of building high-performing technical teams and developing future architecture leaders.
